jobs.title: React Native Developer (Wallet team) - 100% remote
jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 The role involves working in a dynamic environment with a diverse team of senior backend developers, product managers and leadership to build crypto wallet solutions . The applications are meant to be high performance, light-weight and highly intuitive to cater to a variety of audiences.
 You will be working on developing cutting edge mobile applications integrating crypto wallets and defi features.

Responsibilities

• Development: Design and build advanced and secure cross platform applications for the [iOS/Android] platform using React Native. Collaborate with UI/UX designers to ensure applications are visually appealing and intuitive.

• Integration: Work closely with backend developers and integrate Javascript SDKs, libraries, and backend services into mobile applications.

• Collaboration: Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other developers to deliver innovative solutions.

Mandatory

• 3+ years of experience with React , React-Native (mainly around Expo) , Redux and the core principles surrounding these.

• Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+ .

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines for mobile development .

• Familiar with modern front-end pipelines and tools .

• Experienced with Native modules (C++) , WebSockets, RESTful based APIs .

• Experience in Swift/Objective-C (iOS) or Kotlin/Java (Android) for low level implementation.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

## Tether: Unisciti a noi per plasmare il futuro della finanza digitale Al Tether, non stiamo solo considerando prodotti, stiamo rivoluzionando la finanza globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende - dalle borse e dalle portafogli ai processori di pagamento e alle macchine per il denaro - di integrare in modo fluido token garantiti da riserve su blockchain. Sfruttando il potere della tecnologia blockchain, il Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere token digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, a un costo inferiore del 10%. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo la fiducia in ogni transazione. # Innovare con Tether # Tether Finance: La nostra suite di prodotti innovativi comprende la stablecoin più affidata al mondo, USDT, usata da centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme a servizi di tokenizzazione di asset digitali pionieristici. Ma questo è solo l'inizio: - Tether Power: La nostra soluzione per il potere ottimizza l'energia in eccesso per il mining del Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche ecocompatibili in strutture di ultima generazione e geo-diverse. - Tether Data: La nostra soluzione per i dati alimentari i progressi nell'intelligenza artificiale e nella tecnologia peer-to-peer, conseguente i costi di infrastrutture e strategie globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET, il nostro app di bandiera che risce la condivisione di dati sicuri e privati. - Tether Education: La nostra soluzione per l'istruzione democratizza l'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, volendo alle persone di prosperare nelle economie digitali e di gig, promuovendo la crescita globale e l'opportunità. - Tether Evolution: Al confini tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i limiti di ciò che è possibile, creando un futuro in cui l'innovazione e le capacità umane si fondono in modi potenzi e inediti. # Perché unirti a noi? Il nostro team è una potenza di talento globale, che lavora a distanza da ogni angolo del mondo. Se sei appassionato di lasciare un segno nel settore fintech, questo è il tuo per collaborare con alcuni dei cervelli più brillanti, spingendo i limiti endo stabili nuovi standard. Abbiamo cresciuto rapidamente, tenuto la nostra flessibilità e considerando il nostro posto come leader nell'industria. Se hai eccellenti abilità di comunicazione in inglese e sei pronto a contribuire al più innovativo piattaforma del pianeta, il Tether è il posto giusto per te. Sei pronto a essere parte del futuro? ## Descrizione del lavoro Il ruolo prevede di lavorare in un ambiente favorevole con un team diversificato di senior sviluppatori backend, manager di prodotto e leadership per costruire soluzioni per portafogli criptovaluta. Le applicazioni sono dirette per essere alta prestazione, leggere e intuitive per soddisfare una varietà di pubblici. Sarai coinvolto nello sviluppo di applicazioni mobili avanzate che integrano portafogli criptovaluta e funzionalità DeFi. ## Responsabilità - Sviluppo: Progetta e costruisci applicazioni avanzate e sicure per piattaforme [iOS/Android] utilizzando React Native. Collabora con i designer di UI/UX per garantire che le applicazioni siano visivamente dotatinti e intuitive. - Integrazione: Lavora in stretta collaborazione con gli sviluppatori backend e integra SDK Javascript, librerie e servizi backend nelle applicazioni mobili. - Collaborazione: Collabora con i manager di prodotto, i designer e gli altri sviluppatori per trovare soluzioni innovative. ##
• Requisiti obbligatori - 3+ anni di esperienza con React, React-Native (principalmente intorno a Expo), Redux e i principi fondamentali che li circondano. - Proficienti in JavaScript e ES6+. - Esperienza con pipeline CI/CD per lo sviluppo mobile. - Familiarità con pipeline front-end moderne e strumenti. - Esperienza con moduli presepe (C++), WebSockets, API basate su REST. - Esperienza in Swift/Objective-C (iOS) o Kotlin/Java (Android) per implementazioni a basso livello. ## Informazioni importanti per i candidati Gli schemi di reclutamento sono diventati sempre più comuni. Per proteggerti, tenere presente le seguenti informazioni quando si applica a ruoli: - Si applichi solo attraverso i nostri canali ufficiali. Non usate terze o agenzie per la reclutamento a meno che non sia stato chiaramente indicato. Tutti i ruoli aperti sono elencati sulla nostra pagina di carriera ufficiale: https://tether.recruitee.com/ - Verifica l'identità del reclutatore. Tutti i nostri reclutatori hanno profili LinkedIn verificati. Se sei incerto, puoi confermare la loro identità controllando il loro profilo o contattandoci attraverso il nostro sito web. - Sii cauto con i metodi di comunicazione insoliti. Non favoramo interviste su WhatsApp, Telegram o SMS. Tutta la comunicazione viene fatta attraverso email ufficiali e piattaforme della società. - Controlla gli indirizzi. Tutta la comunicazione da parte nostra verrà da e-mail che terminano con @tether.to o @tether.io - Non richiederemo mai pagamenti o informazioni finanziarie personali. Se qualcuno chiede informazioni finanziarie personali o pagamenti in qualsiasi momento durante il processo di assunzione, si tratta di uno schema. Segnala immediatamente. Quando hai doppiato, sentiti libero di contattarci attraverso il nostro sito web ufficiale.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Beschreibung Schließen Sie sich Tether an und gestalten Sie die Zukunft der digitalen Finanzwelt Bei Tether entwickeln wir nicht nur Produkte, sondern treiben eine globale Finanzrevolution voran. Unsere hochmodernen Lösungen ermöglichen es Unternehmen – von Börsen und Wallets bis hin zu Zahlungsabwicklern und Geldautomaten – Reserve-gestützte Token nahtlos in Blockchains zu integrieren. Durch die Nutzung der Blockchain-Technologie ermöglicht Tether Ihnen, digitale Token sofort, sicher und weltweit zu speichern, zu senden und zu empfangen – und das zu einem Bruchteil der Kosten. Transparenz ist das Fundament all dessen, was wir tun, und gewährleistet Vertrauen in jede Transaktion. Innovieren Sie mit Tether Tether Finance: Unsere innovative Produktpalette umfasst den weltweit vertrauenswürdigsten Stablecoin, USDT, der von Hunderten Millionen weltweit genutzt wird, sowie wegweisende Dienstleistungen zur Tokenisierung digitaler Vermögenswerte. Aber das ist erst der Anfang: Tether Power: Mit nachhaltigem Wachstum als Ziel optimieren unsere Energielösungen überschüssige Energie für das Bitcoin-Mining unter Verwendung umweltfreundlicher Praktiken in hochmodernen, geografisch diversifizierten Einrichtungen. Tether Data: Durchbrüche in KI und Peer-to-Peer-Technologie treiben wir voran, indem wir Infrastrukturkosten senken und die globale Kommunikation mit innovativen Lösungen wie KEET verbessern – unserer Vorzeige-App, die sichere und private Datenfreigabe neu definiert. Tether Education: Wir demokratisieren den Zugang zu erstklassigem digitalen Lernen und befähigen Einzelpersonen, in der digitalen und Gig-Wirtschaft erfolgreich zu sein, was globales Wachstum und Chancen fördert. Tether Evolution: An der Schnittstelle von Technologie und menschlichem Potenzial verschieben wir die Grenzen des Möglichen und gestalten eine Zukunft, in der Innovation und menschliche Fähigkeiten auf kraftvolle, beispiellose Weise verschmelzen. Warum zu uns kommen? Unser Team ist eine globale Talent-Powerhouse, das aus allen Ecken der Welt remote arbeitet. Wenn Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert sind, im Fintech-Bereich Spuren zu hinterlassen, ist dies Ihre Chance, mit einigen der klügsten Köpfe zusammenzuarbeiten, Grenzen zu verschieben und neue Standards zu setzen. Wir sind schnell gewachsen, schlank geblieben und haben uns als Branchenführer etabliert. Wenn Sie über ausgezeichnete Englischkenntnisse verfügen und bereit sind, zur innovativsten Plattform der Welt beizutragen, ist Tether der richtige Ort für Sie. Sind Sie bereit, Teil der Zukunft zu sein? ### Über die Stelle Die Rolle umfasst die Arbeit in einer dynamischen Umgebung mit einem vielfältigen Team von Senior-Backend-Entwicklern, Produktmanagern und Führungskräften, um Krypto-Wallet-Lösungen zu entwickeln. Die Anwendungen sollen leistungsstark, leichtgewichtig und hochintuitiv sein, um eine Vielzahl von Zielgruppen anzusprechen. Sie werden an der Entwicklung modernster mobiler Anwendungen arbeiten, die Krypto-Wallets und DeFi-Funktionen integrieren. ##
• Aufgaben - Entwicklung: Entwerfen und entwickeln Sie fortschrittliche und sichere plattformübergreifende Anwendungen für die [iOS/Android]-Plattform mit React Native. Arbeiten Sie mit UI/UX-Designern zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Anwendungen visuell ansprechend und intuitiv sind. - Integration: Arbeiten Sie eng mit Backend-Entwicklern zusammen und integrieren Sie JavaScript-SDKs, Bibliotheken und Backend-Dienste in mobile Anwendungen. - Zusammenarbeit: Arbeiten Sie mit Produktmanagern, Designern und anderen Entwicklern zusammen, um innovative Lösungen zu liefern. ##
• Anforderungen - 3+ Jahre Erfahrung mit React, React-Native (hauptsächlich mit Expo), Redux und den Kernprinzipien. - Sehr gute Kenntnisse in JavaScript und ES6+. - Erfahrung mit CI/CD-Pipelines für die mobile Entwicklung. - Vertrautheit mit modernen Frontend-Pipelines und Tools. - Erfahrung mit nativen Modulen (C++), WebSockets, RESTful-APIs. - Erfahrung in Swift/Objective-C (iOS) oder Kotlin/Java (Android) für Low-Level-Implementierungen. ## Wichtige Informationen für Bewerber Betrugsversuche bei der Rekrutierung nehmen zu. Um sich zu schützen, beachten Sie bitte Folgendes, wenn Sie sich auf Stellen bewerben: - Bewerben Sie sich nur über unsere offiziellen Kanäle. Wir nutzen keine Drittanbieterplattformen oder -agenturen für die Rekrutierung, es sei denn, dies ist ausdrücklich angegeben. Alle offenen Stellen sind auf unserer offiziellen Karriereseite aufgeführt: https://tether.recruitee.com/ - Überprüfen Sie die Identität des Recruiters. Alle unsere Recruiter haben verifizierte LinkedIn-
• Profile. Wenn Sie unsicher sind, können Sie deren Identität überprüfen, indem Sie ihr Profil überprüfen oder uns über unsere Website kontaktieren. - Seien Sie vorsichtig bei ungewöhnlichen Kommunikationsmethoden. Wir führen keine Interviews über WhatsApp, Telegram oder SMS. Alle Kommunikation erfolgt über offizielle Firmen-E-Mails und Plattformen. - Überprüfen Sie E-Mail-Adressen doppelt. Alle unsere E-Mails enden mit @tether.to oder @tether.io. - Wir werden niemals Zahlungen oder finanzielle Details anfordern. Wenn jemand während des Einstellungsprozesses persönliche Finanzinformationen oder Zahlungen anfordert, handelt es sich um einen Betrug. Bitte melden Sie dies umgehend. - Wenn Sie Zweifel haben, zögern Sie nicht, uns über unsere offizielle Website zu kontaktieren.

About the job
 As part of the Technology Distribution team of Tether Data, the Solutions Partner Manager is responsible for managing, enabling, and governing a network of consulting firms, system integrators, and delivery partners who implement Tether products (WDK, QVAC, and MOS). The role ensures partners deliver high-quality projects, align with Tether’s interests, meet certification standards, and drive customer satisfaction.

Responsibilities
 1. Partner Relationship & Capability Management

• Act as the primary relationship owner for all Solutions Partners.

• Coordinate the assessment of partner capabilities, delivery maturity, and resources.

• Ensure partners maintain sufficient certified consultants and technical capacity.

• Conduct regular capability reviews and develop partner improvement plans as needed.

2. Partner Onboarding & Certification

• Lead the onboarding of new implementation partners, including due diligence and contract execution.

• Coordinate partner training and certification programs

• Ensure adherence to implementation playbooks, best practices, and delivery frameworks.

3. Delivery Governance

• Oversee partner-led implementations to ensure alignment with methodology, quality standards, and timelines.

• Participate in project kick-offs, milestone reviews, and governance checkpoints.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

• We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship in 2025/2026. MSc/PhD Internships at Tether aim to provide students with the opportunity to actively contribute to our products and research, and to the organization's future plans and emerging technologies.

• In our team, you will have the opportunity to participate in the development of the state-of-the-art (SOTA) foundation models, and will also be responsible for optimizing our distributed model training framework continuously.

• PhD internships at Tether provide students with the opportunity to actively contribute to our products and research, and to the organization's future plans and emerging technologies. Our dynamic internship experience blends hands-on learning, enriching community-building and development events, and collaboration with industry experts.

• Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We encourage you to apply early. Please state your availability clearly in your resume (Start date, End date).

Responsibilities

• Research and develop state-of-the-art LLM and/or video or multimodality models to accelerate open-source progress in the domains.

• Implement the application of large models in our business scenarios, like pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, post-training, inference etc.

• Continuously optimize the training framework to better adapt to the training of large models on thousands of multi-node GPUs.

• In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to advance the development of open-source LLM, vision and/or multimodal foundation models and products. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with broader teams across Tether.

• MSc/PhD candidate in computer science or a related technical discipline

• Related Research Experience at least one of the following areas: LLM, computer vision, multimodality

• Be proficient with PyTorch deep learning framework and libraries

• Have excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, logical thinking skills, communication and collaboration skills

• Publications in the top AI conferences (e.g., ACL, NIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, TPAMI, IJCV, etc.) is a nice to have.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

About the job
 As part of the Technology Distribution team of Tether Data, we are seeking a highly organized and strategically minded Account Manager to oversee complex, cross-functional initiatives involving digital wallets and payments, asset tokenization, P2P technologies, and decentralized AI. The role combines client engagement, project governance, and multi-stakeholder coordination across external companies, government entities, and internal teams.
 This position is pivotal in ensuring timely delivery of strategic programs, maintaining alignment between stakeholders, and supporting the deployment of transformational technologies in a fast-paced, regulated environment.

Responsibilities
 Client & Partner Engagement

• Act as the primary point of contact for clients and institutional partners, ensuring consistent communication, expectation management, and long-term relationship building.

• Coordinate with external companies providing payment and exchange services, government institutions, and technology vendors.

• Liaise with Expansion team to support the definition of collaboration opportunities across sectors.

• Identify cross-initiative opportunities to introduce and leverage multiple Tether technologies

Project Governance & Delivery Oversight

• Oversee implementation progress led by Product Managers and ensure alignment with contractual terms, expectations, and delivery timelines.

• Maintain governance frameworks including meeting notes, action logs, risk registers, and decision records.

• Drive accountability by ensuring tasks, responsibilities, and milestones are clearly tracked and documented.

• Support escalation management to Head of Technology Distribution and ensure timely resolution of operational or strategic issues.

Cross-Team and Stakeholders Coordination

• Facilitate information flow between internal product, engineering, legal/compliance, marketing and operations teams.

• Maintain dashboards and executive reports summarizing status, risks, and next steps.

• Engage and maintain relationships with external companies involved in the initiative at all levels

• 5+ years of experience in account management, program coordination, or project governance within technology, fintech, or consulting environments.

• Proven ability to engage with corporate and government stakeholders at multiple levels.

• Strong understanding of digital assets, blockchain, or financial technology ecosystems (experience with tokenization, custodial solutions, or payment infrastructure is a plus).

• Excellent communication, documentation, and analytical skills.

• Strong sense of ownership, initiative, and ability to operate in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

• English is a must, any other language a plus

• Crypto/blockchain/AI sourcing and vendor management expertise is an advantage

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Tether e la tua futura carriera ### Descrizione Unisciti a Tether e contribuisci a plasmare il futuro della finanza digitale At Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, stiamo rivoluzionando il panorama finanziario globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende - dalle borse e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e alle bancomat - di integrare in modo fluido token garantiti da riserve su blockchain. Sfruttando il potere della tecnologia blockchain, Tether ti consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere token digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, a un costo inferiore del 10%. L'innovazione è il nostro pilastro, assicurando la trasparenza in ogni transazione. ### Innovare con Tether Tether Finance: La nostra suite di prodotti innovativi comprende la stablecoin più affidata al mondo, USDT, utilizzata da centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme a servizi di tokenizzazione di asset digitali pionieristici. Ma questo è solo l'inizio: Tether Power: La nostra soluzione per il potenziamento sostenibile ottimizza l'energia in eccesso per il mining del Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche ecocompatibili in strutture di ultima generazione e geo-diverse. Tether Data: I nostri strumenti di avanzata tecnologia riducono i costi di infrastruttura e migliorano le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni come KEET, il nostro app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione di dati sicuri e privati. Tether Education : La democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello consente alle persone di prosperare nelle economie digitali e gig, promuovendo la crescita e l'opportunità globali. Tether Evolution : Al confine tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i limiti di ciò che è possibile, creando un futuro in cui l'innovazione e le capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e inediti. ### Perché unirti a noi? Il nostro team è una potenza di talento globale, che lavora a distanza da ogni angolo del mondo. Se sei appassionato di lasciare il tuo segno nel settore fintech, questo è il tuo momento per collaborare con alcuni dei cervelli più brillanti, spingendo i limiti e stabilendo nuovi standard. Abbiamo cresciuto rapidamente, mantenuto la nostra struttura snella e assicurato il nostro posto di leader nel settore. Se hai eccellenti abilità di comunicazione in inglese e sei pronto a contribuire al più innovativo platform del pianeta, Tether è il posto giusto per te. Sei pronto a essere parte del futuro? ### Informazioni sul lavoro Come Filmmaker AI, utilizzerai strumenti di generazione di foto e video basati sull'intelligenza artificiale per concepire, creare e editare cortometraggi e video. Questi video saranno utilizzati per raccontare storie, presentare prodotti e portare le visioni di Tether e delle sue società affiliate alla vita. ### Responsabilità - Creare cortometraggi e video utilizzando strumenti di generazione di foto e video basati sull'intelligenza artificiale. - Editare e perfezionare il contenuto generato dall'intelligenza artificiale per produrre visuali di alta qualità e coinvolgenti. - Collaborare con i colleghi del team di marketing per sviluppare concetti di video per Tether e altre marche affiliate. - Assicurarsi che tutti i contenuti video siano in linea con le linee guida della marca e comunicino i messaggi chiave in modo efficace. - Restare aggiornato sulle ultime tecnologie e tecniche di filmmaking con AI, incorporando innovazioni nel proprio workflow. - Gestire più progetti con scadenze strette, assicurando la consegna tempestiva. - Sperimentare con formati, stili e effetti creativi per produrre contenuti unici e memorabili. ###
• Requisiti - Esperienza provata nella produzione e editing di video, con un portafoglio di lavoro solido. - Abilità nella generazione di video con strumenti AI (ad esempio, Runway, Stable Diffusion, MidJourney, DALL-E o altri). - Esperto in software di editing video (ad esempio, Adobe Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve). - Abilità di raccontare storie creative con un occhio attento per la composizione visiva e i dettagli. - Capacità di concepire e eseguire idee rapidamente utilizzando strumenti AI. - Familiarità con il marketing digitale e capacità di adattare il contenuto per piattaforme di social media. - Abilità di gestire progetti e organizzare il lavoro, con la capacità di lavorare indipendentemente e rispettare i tempi di consegna. - Passione per la tecnologia, il bitcoin e l'innovazione (un plus). ###
• Cosa offriamo - Compensazione competitiva. - Opportunità di lavorare con un team globale su progetti all'avanguardia. - Flessibilità di lavorare a distanza. - Accesso a strumenti e risorse di AI avanzati. - Un ambiente collaborativo in cui la tua creatività avrà un impatto diretto sulla narrazione della marca.

Tether und deine Zukunft ### Beschreibung Bist du bereit, Teil von Tether zu werden und den Zukunft der digitalen Finanzen zu gestalten? Bei Tether bauen wir nicht nur Produkte, wir revolutionieren den globalen Finanzmarkt. Unsere fortschrittlichen Lösungen ermöglichen es Unternehmen - von Börsen und Portfolios bis hin zu Zahlungssystemen und Bankautomaten - tokens mit garantierten Reserven auf der Blockchain zu integrieren. Durch die Nutzung der Blockchain-Technologie ermöglicht Tether es dir, tokens digital zu speichern, zu senden und zu empfangen, sofort, sicher und global, zu einem Kostenrabatt von 10%. Innovation ist unser Leitprinzip, das Transparenz in jeder Transaktion gewährleistet. ### Innovieren mit Tether Tether Finance: Unsere innovative Produkt-Suite umfasst die weltweit vertrauenswürdigste Stablecoin, USDT, die von Hunderten Millionen Menschen weltweit verwendet wird, zusammen mit Pionierleistungen in der Tokenisierung digitaler Vermögenswerte. Aber das ist nur der Anfang: Tether Power: Unsere Lösung für nachhaltige Leistungsoptimierung nutzt überschüssige Energie für den Bitcoin-Mining mit umweltfreundlichen Methoden in modernen, geo-verteilten Strukturen. Tether Data: Unsere fortschrittlichen Technologien reduzieren die Infrastrukturkosten und verbessern die globale Kommunikation mit Lösungen wie KEET, unserem Flaggschiff-App, die die sichere und private Datenverteilung neu definiert. Tether Education : Die Demokratisierung des Zugangs zu hochwertigem digitalen Lernen ermöglicht es Menschen, in digitalen und Gig-Ökonomien zu prosperieren, die Wachstum und globale Chancen fördert. Tether Evolution : Am Schnittpunkt von Technologie und menschlichem Potenzial drücken wir die Grenzen dessen, was möglich ist, und schaffen einen Zukunft, in der Innovation und menschliche Fähigkeiten in neuen und kraftvollen Wegen zusammenfließen. ### Warum bist du Teil von uns? Unser Team ist eine globale Kraft aus Talenten, die von jedem Winkel der Welt aus arbeitet. Wenn du begeistert bist, deinen Einfluss im FinTech-Sektor zu hinterlassen, ist dies dein Moment, um mit einigen der brillantesten Köpfe zusammenzuarbeiten, Grenzen zu sprengen und neue Standards zu setzen. Wir haben schnell gewachsen, unsere Struktur erhalten und unseren Platz als Führer im Sektor gesichert. Wenn du ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Englisch hast und bereit bist, zum innovativsten Plattform der Welt beizutragen, ist Tether der richtige Ort für dich. Bist du bereit, Teil der Zukunft zu werden? ### Arbeitsinformationen Als AI-Filmmaker wirst du Tools für die generative Bild- und Videoproduktion basierend auf künstlicher Intelligenz verwenden, um Kurzfilme und Videos zu konzipieren, zu erstellen und zu bearbeiten. Diese Videos werden verwendet, um Geschichten zu erzählen, Produkte vorzustellen und die Visionen von Tether und seinen verbundenen Unternehmen in das Leben zu bringen. ###

jobs.title: Social Media Manager (100% remote)
jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 We’re seeking a Social Media Manager focused on Tether tech products and events. You will plan, coordinate, and implement social media campaigns and community growth strategies — supporting product launches, engagement, education, and user outreach globally. You will also be encouraged to leverage AI tools to generate creative content ideas and concepts, helping the team explore new ways to communicate our products and initiatives (AI-generated ideas are for internal review and ideation, not for direct publishing).

Responsibilities:

• Develop and implement a social media strategy aligned with product launches, marketing goals, and audience needs

• Create, edit, and publish content across platforms (e.g., X/Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn, Telegram)

• Manage content calendars, posting schedules, and distribution plans in coordination with global marketing and product teams

• Work closely with product managers to communicate updates, new features, and benefits of Tether products

• Collaborate with partners, influencers, and community leaders to drive awareness and trust

• Track key performance indicators (KPIs) — engagement, growth, reach — and report campaign results to senior stakeholders

• Adapt messaging for clarity, cultural relevance, and brand consistency

• Use AI tools to brainstorm content ideas, visuals, and messaging frameworks to enhance campaigns (ideas only, not for final publication)

Requirements:

• 3–5 years of professional experience in social media management, ideally in fintech or tech sectors

• Fluent in English (writing and speaking); Spanish is a bonus

• Proven ability to grow and engage online communities across multiple social platforms

• Skills in content creation — copywriting, basic graphics or multimedia (images, GIFs, short video)

• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage deadlines, priorities, and cross-team coordination

• Autonomous, self-starter attitude; able to work remotely and collaborate across time zones

• Basic understanding of Bitcoin / stablecoins / blockchain products is preferred

• Familiarity or willingness to use AI tools to generate creative social media concepts

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

 Project & Workflow Management

 • Ensure projects are delivered on time, on scope, and aligned with business objectives

Cross-Functional Alignment
 • Serve as the primary liaison between Marketing, Product, and Development to ensure alignment on priorities and execution

Partecipa a Tether e Scegli di Formare il Futuro della Finanza Digitale A Tether, non stiamo solo considerando i prodotti, stiamo rivoluzionando il futuro della finanza digitale a livello globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende - dalle borse e dalle portafogli ai processori di pagamento e alle macchine per il denaro - di integrare in modo trasparente i token garantiti da riserve su blockchain. Sfruttando il potere della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere token digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, a un costo un inferiore del 10%. ## Innovare con Tether Tether Finance: La nostra innovazione suite di prodotti comprende la più attendibile stablecoin al mondo, USDT, utilizzata da centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme ai servizi di tokenizzazione di asset digitali pionieristici. Ma questo è solo l'inizio: Tether Power: La nostra soluzione per il potenziamento sostenibile l'eccesso di potenza per il mining del Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche ecocompatibili in strutture di ultima generazione e geo-diverse. Tether Data: Le nostre soluzioni di ultima generazione ho costi di infrastruttura e migliorano le comunicazioni globali con tecnologie avanzate come KEET, il nostro app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione di dati sicuri e privati. Tether Education: La democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello consente alle persone di prosperare nelle economie digitali e di gig, promuovendo la crescita e l'opportunità globali. Tether Evolution: Al confini tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i limiti di ciò che è possibile, creando un futuro in cui l'innovazione e le capacità umane si fondono in modi potenzi e inediti. # Perché Unirti a Noi? Il nostro team è una potenza di talento globale, che lavora a distanza da ogni angolo del mondo. Se sei appassionato di lasciare un segno nel settore fintech, questo è il tuo per collaborare con alcuni dei cervelli più brillanti, spingendo i limiti endo stabili nuovi standard. Abbiamo cresciuto rapidamente, tenuto la nostra struttura snella e deriva il nostro posto come leader nel settore. Se hai eccellenti abilità di comunicazione in inglese e sei pronto a contribuire al più innovativo piattaforma del pianeta, Tether è il posto per te. Sei pronto a essere parte del futuro? ## Descrizione del lavoro In questo ruolo fondamentale, impiegaerai le tue competenze per costruire soluzioni backend robuste, scalabili e sicure che servono alla missione di Tether di rivoluzionare il futuro della finanza digitale. ## Mansioni - Creare progetti innovativi, utilizzando metodi agili e tecnologie innovative per creare piattaforme incredibili. - Assicurare che i servizi backend restano facilmente rispondenti e in tempo reale, adattandosi alla crescita continua e all'evoluzione della piattaforma e del suo utente. - Mantenere gli standard di sicurezza più alti in tutti i processi e i servizi backend per proteggere i beni e i dati degli utenti. ##
• Requisiti - Esperto di Node.js e JavaScript. - Familiarità con l'architettura dei microservizi per applicazioni scalabili. - Esperienza nell'attiva sviluppo di piattaforme complesse. - Capacità di interagire con database come MySQL e MongoDB. - Capacità di adattarsi e imparare rapidamente nuove tecnologie. - Consapevolezza e esperienza nell'implementazione delle migliori pratiche di sicurezza. # Cosa# offrendo - Opportunità di lavorare con un team di talento globale. - Ambiente di lavoro innovativo e dinamico. - Possibilità di contribuire a progetti innovativi e di impatto. - Opportunità di crescita e sviluppo professionale. ## Contatto Per ulteriori informazioni o per candidarti, visita il nostro sito web ufficiale: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Attenzione: i reclutatori falsi sono sempre più comuni. Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. About the job
In this pivotal role, you will leverage your expertise to build robust, scalable, and secure backend solutions that contribute to Tether’s mission of pioneering a decentralized future in digital finance. This is an opportunity to take on formidable challenges and make a significant impact on our cutting-edge, global platform.

Responsibilities

• Innovative Solutions: Contribute to the creation of groundbreaking projects, utilizing agile methodologies and innovative technologies to create incredible platforms.

• Scalability: Ensure backend services remain effortlessly responsive and real-time, accommodating the platform's continual growth and evolving user base.

• Security: Uphold the highest security standards in all backend processes and services to safeguard our users' assets and data.

• Node/JavaScript Expertise: Very proficient in Node.js and JavaScript programming.

• Microservices Architecture: Familiarity with microservices architecture for scalable applications.

• Complex Platform Development: Experience in actively developing complex platforms.

 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 Tether and its affiliated entities (e.g. Bitfinex) are searching for an organized self-starter to join our Regulatory and Licensing team, to lead efforts in the Middle East. The successful candidate is someone with an understanding of the regulatory environment pertaining to the crypto-asset industry / stablecoin industry in the Middle East, and who is excited by the opportunity to apply their existing legal and / or regulatory experience in an exciting and dynamic business environment.
 To succeed in this role, the incumbent will continuously strive to self-develop and enhance their skill sets including understanding the Company’s products and services, blockchain technology, and regulatory requirements.
 You will have a focus around working with regulators to translate policy objectives of the companies into favourable regulatory requirements in the region, as part of enabling the broader business strategy across Tether’s business verticals.
 The successful candidate should be comfortable managing relationships and communications between various stakeholders both internal and external to the business, including regulators and policy setters, as well as working with cross-functional teams such as Operations, Finance, Technology, Business Development.
 You will report to the Vice President of the Regulatory and Licensing division, and work alongside project managers and members of the wider business to execute on regulatory affairs initiatives.

Responsibilities:
 Regulatory Affairs

• Monitor regulatory developments impacting Tether and affiliates companies in the region.

• Maintain active relationships with policymakers, regulators, central banks, and financial intelligence units.

• Represent the company in consultations, workshops, industry roundtables, and regulatory dialogues.

• Prepare briefing papers, comment letters, and policy submissions aligned with broader global regulatory strategy.

• Identify and successfully realise opportunities to shape emerging frameworks in a risk-sensitive, innovation-oriented manner.

Licensing & Authorisations

• Conduct structured assessments on whether licensing/registration is required for operations in the region.

• Working with your team and local advisor, you will be responsible for successfully obtaining regulatory authorisations in the region, where required.

Strategy & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Support enterprise-level planning for new products or expansions in the region, advising on regulatory constraints and enablers to the Company’s leadership.

• Contribute to internal reporting and executive briefings on policy risks and regulatory trajectory regionally.

• Minimum of 8 years governmental affairs / regulatory affairs / legal experience ideally within the financial services or crypto-asset industry in the Middle East.

• Proven ability in successfully leading regulatory affairs teams within either the financial services industry, or the digital asset industry.

• Demonstrated experience working with regulators and government bodies advocating and advising in a regulatory capacity, with demonstrated achievements securing favourable policy positions on behalf of another organisation.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesise complex regulatory topics for non-technical audiences.

• Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders across borders and time zones.

• Communication: Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with experience in public speaking and representing companies in regulatory discussions.

• Must be a strong team player, and willing to be fully engaged with key stakeholders both in our company but also with our partners. Must be a hands-on professional capable of working collaboratively and independently.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 Tether and its affiliated entities (e.g. Bitfinex) are searching for an organized self-starter to join our Regulatory and Licensing team as Head of Licensing and Regulatory Authorisations. The successful candidate is someone with an understanding of the regulatory environment pertaining to the digital-asset industry / stablecoin industry, and who is excited by the opportunity to apply their existing legal and / or regulatory experience in an exciting and dynamic business environment.
 The Head of Licensing and Regulatory Authorisations will lead the development and execution of our global authorisations strategy across key jurisdictions, working through a geographically distributed team of regional regulatory affairs and licensing teams. This role is responsible for securing and maintaining regulatory approvals required for the company’s operations, ensuring alignment with shifting regulatory landscapes, and enabling sustainable market expansion.
 As a senior leader within the Regulatory Affairs & Licensing function, you will collaborate closely with regional licensing personnel, legal, compliance, product, and executive leadership to drive licensing initiatives end-to-end—from early regulatory assessments and submissions through to supervisory engagement and operational readiness. The ideal candidate brings deep multi-jurisdictional licensing expertise, exceptional stakeholder management skills, and the ability to coordinate across regions in a cohesive, consistent manner.
 You will report to the Vice President of the Regulatory Affairs and Licensing division, and work alongside project managers and members of the wider business to execute on regulatory and licensing initiatives.

Responsibilities
 Licensing Strategy & Execution

• Design and implement a unified global licensing strategy, ensuring consistency across regional approaches.

• Work closely with regional licensing personnel to assess regulatory pathways, evaluate market feasibility, and prioritise jurisdictions.

• Oversee and guide the preparation, submission, and management of licensing applications and / or other regulatory authorisation processes, in collaboration with regional teams.

• Ensure alignment between regional licensing efforts and global business priorities.

Regional Coordination & Stakeholder Management

• Serve as the central point of coordination for licensing and regulatory authorisation activity across all regions, ensuring standards, documentation, and approaches remain cohesive.

• Provide direct support, guidance, and escalation oversight to regional licensing personnel.

• Align regulatory authorisation efforts with regulatory affairs leads to coordinate regulatory engagement strategies across regions.

Regulatory Engagement

• Act as a senior representative in regulatory engagements where global coordination or executive-level involvement is required.

• Support regional teams in interactions with local regulators, offering strategic guidance and ensuring consistent messaging.

Operational Readiness & Governance

• Coordinate with regional teams to ensure their understanding around local regulatory requirements such that they are prepared to meet jurisdictional authorisation obligations, where needed and / or desired, including governance, capital, operational, and reporting requirements.

• Maintain global oversight of regulatory authorisation conditions, ensuring local compliance is consistent with global policies and standards.

• Lead responses to cross-regional regulatory queries or supervisory reviews related to authorisation activities.

Market Expansion & Risk Analysis

• Work with regional personnel to conduct regulatory feasibility assessments for new markets and product expansions.

• Provide strategic recommendations to executive leadership on prioritisation of authorisation efforts and regulatory risk.

Team Leadership

• Lead and mentor the global regulatory and licensing team, including regional leads and supporting personnel.

• Build capability, consistency, and knowledge-sharing across regions to strengthen the company’s global licensing and authorisations function.

• Promote a culture of regulatory excellence, transparency, and disciplined execution.

Experience & Expertise

• 10+ years of experience in regulatory licensing and authorisations, regulatory affairs, compliance, or related fields (financial services, payments, fintech, crypto, or technology).

• Proven experience managing complex regulatory authorisation processes across multiple regions or markets.

• Strong understanding of diverse regulatory frameworks and supervisory expectations globally.

• Experience working within or leading a regional or matrixed team structure is highly preferred.

Skills & Competencies

• Exceptional cross-regional coordination and stakeholder engagement skills.

• Strong project management capabilities and ability to manage complex, multi-jurisdictional workstreams.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, able to synthesise regional inputs into a coherent global strategy.

• Strategic thinker with strong execution discipline.

• Ability to build trust and credibility with regulators and internal leadership.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job Tether and its affiliated entities (e.g. Bitfinex) are searching for an organized self-starter to join our Regulatory and Licensing team as Head of Licensing and Regulatory Authorisations. The successful candidate is someone with an understanding of the regulatory environment pertaining to the digital-asset industry / stablecoin industry, and who is excited by the opportunity to apply their existing legal and / or regulatory experience in an exciting and dynamic business environment. The Head of Licensing and Regulatory Authorisations will lead the development and execution of our global authorisations strategy across key jurisdictions, working through a geographically distributed team of regional regulatory affairs and licensing teams. This role is responsible for securing and maintaining regulatory approvals required for the company’s operations, ensuring alignment with shifting regulatory landscapes, and enabling sustainable market expansion. As a senior leader within the Regulatory Affairs & Licensing function, you will collaborate closely with regional licensing personnel, legal, compliance, product, and executive leadership to drive licensing initiatives end-to-end—from early regulatory assessments and submissions through to supervisory engagement and operational readiness. The ideal candidate brings deep multi-jurisdictional licensing expertise, exceptional stakeholder management skills, and the ability to coordinate across regions in a cohesive, consistent manner. You will report to the Vice President of the Regulatory Affairs and Licensing division, and work alongside project managers and members of the wider business to execute on regulatory and licensing initiatives. Responsibilities Licensing Strategy & Execution
• Design and implement a unified global licensing strategy, ensuring consistency across regional approaches.
• Work closely with regional licensing personnel to assess regulatory pathways, evaluate market feasibility, and prioritise jurisdictions.
• Oversee and guide the preparation, submission, and management of licensing applications and / or other regulatory authorisation processes, in collaboration with regional teams.
• Ensure alignment between regional licensing efforts and global business priorities. Regional Coordination & Stakeholder Management
• Serve as the central point of coordination for licensing and regulatory authorisation activity across all regions, ensuring standards, documentation, and approaches remain cohesive.
• Provide direct support, guidance, and escalation oversight to regional licensing personnel.
• Align regulatory authorisation efforts with regulatory affairs leads to coordinate regulatory engagement strategies across regions. Regulatory Engagement
• Act as a senior representative in regulatory engagements where global coordination or executive-level involvement is required.
• Support regional teams in interactions with local regulators, offering strategic guidance and ensuring consistent messaging. Operational Readiness & Governance
• Coordinate with regional teams to ensure their understanding around local regulatory requirements such that they are prepared to meet jurisdictional authorisation obligations, where needed and / or desired, including governance, capital, operational, and reporting requirements.
• Maintain global oversight of regulatory authorisation conditions, ensuring local compliance is consistent with global policies and standards.
• Lead responses to cross-regional regulatory queries or supervisory reviews related to authorisation activities. Market Expansion & Risk Analysis
• Work with regional personnel to conduct regulatory feasibility assessments for new markets and product expansions.
• Provide strategic recommendations to executive leadership on prioritisation of authorisation efforts and regulatory risk. Team Leadership
• Lead and mentor the global regulatory and licensing team, including regional leads and supporting personnel.
• Build capability, consistency, and knowledge-sharing across regions to strengthen the company’s global licensing and authorisations function.
• Promote a culture of regulatory excellence, transparency, and disciplined execution. Experience & Expertise
• 10+ years of experience in regulatory licensing and authorisations, regulatory affairs, compliance, or related fields (financial services, payments, fintech, crypto, or technology).
• Proven experience managing complex regulatory authorisation processes across multiple regions or markets.
• Strong understanding of diverse regulatory frameworks and supervisory expectations globally.
• Experience working within or leading a regional or matrixed team structure is highly preferred. Skills & Competencies
• Exceptional cross-regional coordination and stakeholder engagement skills.
• Strong project management capabilities and ability to manage complex, multi-jurisdictional workstreams.
• Excellent written and verbal communication, able to synthesise regional inputs into a coherent global strategy.
• Strategic thinker with strong execution discipline.
• Ability to build trust and credibility with regulators and internal leadership. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 Tether is seeking an experienced and visionary Head of Regulatory Affairs to design and execute global regulatory affairs strategies for our Tether Data business vertical. At Tether Data, we are committed to pioneering advancements in AI and peer-to-peer (P2P) technologies. Our mission is to innovate and lead in the creation of technological solutions that empower people, communities, cities and countries to become more independent and sovereign. In a world constantly changing and becoming more unpredictable, technology should be used to ensure freedom and respect of human rights, rather than capturing people’s private digital lives.

Responsibilities

• Policy Advocacy, Monitoring, Analysis and Guidance : Monitor, analyse and communicate changes in global regulatory policies, and advise executive leadership on potential regulatory risks and opportunities, while driving initiatives to influence regulatory frameworks as well as monitoring for change across regulations to ensure proactive compliance where required.

• Regulatory Advocacy and Thought Leadership : Leading or participating in regulatory agency interactions and advocacy work regarding legislation relevant to this field. Engaging with relevant regulatory authorities, industry bodies, collaborative communities, and policymakers to shape the regulatory landscape for AI and P2P.

• Regulatory Strategy Development : As appropriate, leading the development and execution of regulatory strategies, identifying preferable market/s from which to operate, and to ensure the company’s readiness for compliance with relevant national and international regulations.

• Cross-functional Leadership and Product Development : Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., R&D, legal, compliance) in both Tether and with our partners to to integrate regulatory considerations into the design and deployment of AI models and technologies, as applicable.

• Thought Leadership: Act as a thought leader both externally and within the organization, educating internal teams on regulatory issues, trends, and best practices in the AI and P2P space.

• Proven experience in a senior regulatory role, ideally within the technology, AI, or digital industries.

• Strong knowledge of global AI regulations, data privacy laws (e.g., GDPR), and emerging trends in AI and P2P governance. Legal, compliance, or policy background with a deep understanding of ethical AI principles is a plus.

• Demonstrated understanding of decentralised, self-sovereign and locally executed AI/P2P architectures—and the regulatory implications of these models—distinct from traditional centralised platform approaches.

• Demonstrated experience working with regulators and government bodies advocating and advising in a regulatory capacity, with demonstrated achievements securing favourable policy positions on behalf of another organisation.

• Expertise in preparing complex regulatory documents and other major regulatory submissions, including the preparation and execution of interactions with regulatory authorities.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law, Policy, Computer Science, or related fields.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesise complex regulatory topics for non-technical audiences.

• Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders across borders and time zones.

• Communication: Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with experience in public speaking and representing companies in regulatory discussions.

• Must be a strong team player, and willing to be fully engaged with key stakeholders both in our company but also with our partners. Must be a hands-on professional capable of working collaboratively and independently.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
