About the job
The primary goal of a Developer Relations is to engage, educate, and inspire the developer community - building trust, driving adoption of our technology, and ensuring developers have an exceptional experience with our products. This involves creating technical content, presenting at events, gathering feedback, and serving as the voice of the developer both externally and internally.
The role is focused on bridging the gap between developers and our product teams, ensuring our solutions are accessible, well-understood, and developer-friendly, while fostering community growth, promoting best practices, and driving continuous improvement in how developers discover, learn, and build with our technology.
Pear is a combined Peer-to-Peer (P2P) Runtime, Development & Deployment tool. Pear makes it possible to build, share and extend P2P applications using common Web and Mobile technology. Herein is everything needed to create unstoppable, zero-infrastructure P2P applications for Desktop, Terminal & Mobile.

Responsibilities
Developer Advocacy & Community Building

• Build and nurture relationships with developers, partners, and open-source communities.

• Engage and interact with the developer ecosystem — hosting AMAs, office hours, webinars, and play a part in online communities.

• Collect and synthesize developer feedback to inform product and engineering teams.

• Identify influential developers, projects, and communities to establish collaboration opportunities.

Technical Content & Enablement

• Create and maintain high-quality technical content (blog posts, tutorials, sample apps, videos, documentation, SDK guides, etc.) directly targeted to developers.

• Develop demos, prototypes, and reference implementations that showcase real-world use cases.

• Contribute to improving developer experience through documentation feedback, onboarding flows, and API design suggestions.

• Support developer onboarding through workshops, hackathons, and training sessions.

Product Evangelism

• Advocate for the company’s technology stack at industry events, developer meetups, and online communities.

• Translate complex technical concepts into clear, relatable value propositions.

• Collaborate with marketing to align technical storytelling with broader brand messaging.

• Track and report community sentiment and adoption metrics to measure evangelism impact.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner closely with engineering, product management, and marketing to align developer needs with product strategy.

• Provide structured feedback loops between external developers and internal teams to improve product usability.

• Support launch strategies for new developer-facing features, APIs, and SDKs.

• Contribute to roadmap discussions to ensure developer experience remains a strategic priority.

• Support initial technical discussions with potential customers and partners

Thought Leadership

• Represent the company as a credible technical voice in the ecosystem through public speaking, open-source contributions, and community engagement.

• Stay ahead of industry trends, tools, and frameworks relevant to the developer community.

• Mentor internal teams on effective developer communication and community engagement practices.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field - or equivalent professional experience.

• 3+ years of professional software development experience.

• Previous experience as a Developer Advocate, Developer Relations, or Technical Community Manager.

• Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js - able to write production-level code and explain it clearly to other developers.

• Demonstrated experience building, testing, and maintaining applications or APIs.

• Proven ability to create technical content (tutorials, sample projects, blog posts, videos, or documentation) that educates and inspires developers.

• Experience presenting at public events, such as developer conferences, meetups, webinars, or internal company talks.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into simple, engaging messages.

• Experience engaging with developer communities through events, GitHub, forums, or social media.

• Strong understanding of developer experience principles and best practices.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with product, engineering, and marketing teams.

• Strong production experience with React Native and/or Electron (shipping apps that real users love)

• Very comfortable with Node.js and modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems

• English fluency — outstanding written and verbal communication skills are required for public-facing content and developer engagement.

Preferred

• Experience designing, documenting, or promoting SDKs or developer tools.

• Experience developing or integrating apps (web, mobile, or desktop).

• 4–6 years of experience in software development or developer relations.

• Experience leveraging AI tools (such as Cursor, Codex, or similar AI-assisted development workflows) to enhance productivity and problem-solving efficiency

• Contributions to open-source projects or maintaining public GitHub repositories.

• Understanding of DevRel success metrics - content reach, community engagement, and product adoption.

• Experience in technical writing, developer education, or public speaking.

• Passion for community building, mentoring, and empowering developers through content and collaboration.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

You will own the full lifecycle of a crypto wallet product used at global scale, from writing the first user story to shipping the feature to measuring what it actually did. You will set the roadmap, drive every sprint, and be the person every engineer, designer, and stakeholder looks to when a decision needs to be made.

You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.

If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you.

Key responsibilities:

• Product development and Roadmap: Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation and requirements gathering to delivery and post-launch analysis. Define user stories, acceptance criteria, perform backlog management and workflows for development teams.

• Technical Expertise: Translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable product requirements. Evaluate technical solutions and prioritize features based on technical feasibility, business impact, and customer value.

• Conduct extensive market research, including customer discovery to understand the value proposition of our product.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with developers, designers, and other stakeholders to gather requirements, validate and deliver solutions.

• Quality & Delivery: Ensure product features are delivered on time and meet quality standards; organize testing and feedback loops.

Mandatory:

• 8+ years of product management experience with at least 3 years in a technical product management role.

• Past experience in building or managing crypto wallets with DeFi features.

• Excellent communication skills for bridging technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• A genuine team player who builds trust quickly, communicates with candor, and makes the people around them more effective.

• Bias toward action. You identify what needs to change, build the case, and move without waiting to be asked.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and get engineers, designers, and business stakeholders pulling toward the same outcome at the same time.

• Equally comfortable setting the strategy and rolling up your sleeves to execute it. You do not hand things off and disappear.

• Thrives in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. You do your best work when the stakes are high and the timeline is short.

• Expertise in agile methodologies - Jira, Asana etc.

• Strong understanding of microservices, peer-to-peer systems, javascript.

• Strong organizational skills to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced, remote environment.

• Skilled in defining, tracking, and reporting on product KPIs to measure success; expertise in A/B testing or similar experimentation methods is a plus.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

• Esperienza passata nella costruzione o nella gestione di portafogli cripto con funzioni DeFi.

• Allo stesso modo confortevole impostare la strategia e rotolare le maniche per eseguirlo. Non tradisci le cose e sparisci.

• Competenza nelle metodologie agili - Jira, Asana ecc.
• Forte comprensione di microservizi, sistemi peer-to-peer, javascript.

• Abilitato nella definizione, nel tracciamento e nel reporting sui KPI di prodotto per misurare il successo; l'esperienza nei test A/B o simili metodi di sperimentazione è un vantaggio. • Applicare solo attraverso i nostri canali ufficiali. Non utilizziamo piattaforme o agenzie di terze parti per il reclutamento, a meno che non sia chiaro. Tutti i ruoli aperti sono elencati nella nostra pagina di carriera ufficiale: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Doppio check indirizzi e-mail. Tutte le comunicazioni da noi verranno da e-mail che terminano in @ tether.to o @ tether.io
• Non chiederemo mai il pagamento o i dettagli finanziari. Se qualcuno chiede informazioni finanziarie personali o il pagamento in qualsiasi momento durante il processo di assunzione, è una truffa. Si prega di segnalare immediatamente. Quando in dubbio, non esitate a raggiungere il nostro sito ufficiale.

• 8+ Jahre Produktmanagementerfahrung mit mindestens 3 Jahren in einer technischen Produktmanagement-Rolle.
• Frühe Erfahrung in der Konstruktion oder Verwaltung von Krypto-Portets mit DeFi-Funktionen.

Si vous voulez construire quelque chose qui expédie à de vrais utilisateurs, déplace les marchés, et porte vos empreintes digitales du concept à la production, nous voulons entendre de vous. Principales responsabilités :
• Développement des produits et feuille de route : Diriger le cycle de vie des produits de bout en bout, de la collecte d'idées et d'exigences à la livraison et à l'analyse après lancement. Définir les histoires d'utilisateurs, les critères d'acceptation, gérer l'arriéré et les workflows pour les équipes de développement.
• Expertise technique: Traduire des concepts techniques complexes en exigences claires et réalisables. Évaluer les solutions techniques et prioriser les caractéristiques en fonction de la faisabilité technique, de l'impact commercial et de la valeur client.
• Mener une vaste étude de marché, y compris la découverte de clients pour comprendre la proposition de valeur de notre produit.
• Collaboration interfonctionnelle : Travailler avec les développeurs, les concepteurs et d'autres parties prenantes pour recueillir les exigences, valider et fournir des solutions.
• Qualité et livraison: S'assurer que les caractéristiques du produit sont livrées à temps et répondent aux normes de qualité; organiser des tests et des boucles de rétroaction. Obligatoire:
• 8 ans et plus d'expérience en gestion de produits avec au moins 3 ans dans un rôle de gestion technique de produits.
• Expérience passée dans la construction ou la gestion de portefeuilles crypto avec des fonctionnalités DeFi.
• Excellentes compétences en communication pour rapprocher les acteurs techniques et non techniques.
• Un véritable joueur d'équipe qui construit la confiance rapidement, communique avec la candeur et rend les gens autour d'eux plus efficaces.
• Faux sur l'action. Vous identifiez ce qui doit changer, construisez le cas et bougez sans attendre d'être demandé.
• Capacité éprouvée de diriger des équipes interfonctionnelles et d'amener les ingénieurs, les concepteurs et les acteurs commerciaux à atteindre le même résultat en même temps.
• Aussi confortable de mettre en place la stratégie et de rouler vos manches pour l'exécuter. Tu ne laisses pas les choses disparaître.
• Thrives dans un environnement rapide et haute pression. Vous faites votre meilleur travail lorsque les enjeux sont élevés et le calendrier est court.
• Expertise en méthodologie agile - Jira, Asana, etc.
• Forte compréhension des microservices, systèmes peer-to-peer, javascript.
• Des compétences organisationnelles solides permettant d'équilibrer plusieurs priorités dans un environnement rapide et éloigné.

jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 We are developing a highly scalable media intelligence platform that processes, analyzes, and structures large volumes of multimedia content across text, image, video, and audio. As a Senior Applied ML Engineer, you will architect and build the core backend systems that power media ingestion, processing workflows, metadata generation, AI-based analysis, semantic search, and retrieval across large media libraries.
 We are looking for a Senior Applied ML Engineer who can design, implement, optimize, and evaluate a production-grade moderation pipeline using open-source models.

This role requires deep backend engineering expertise, strong system design capability, and practical experience integrating AI/ML systems into production workflows. You will work on complex media-processing pipelines, video/audio analysis, OCR, speech-to-text, embedding generation, vector search, multimodal model integrations, and high-throughput asynchronous workloads. You will collaborate closely with engineering leadership to define backend architecture, improve reliability and scalability, and guide other engineers in delivering secure, observable, and high-performance systems.

Responsibilities
 Backend Architecture & System Ownership

• Architect, build, and operate scalable backend services for a media intelligence platform, with a focus on clean, maintainable, and production-ready systems.

• Own critical backend components end to end, from system design and API contracts through implementation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.

• Drive architectural decisions across APIs, processing pipelines, distributed compute, storage, search, observability, cloud infrastructure, and model-serving workflows.

• Design data models and storage patterns for media assets, generated metadata, embeddings, processing jobs, model outputs, search indexes, and audit trails.

• Design high-throughput media ingestion and processing pipelines for large volumes of video, audio, image, and text content.

• Build distributed, event-driven workflows for media processing using queues and pub/sub systems such as SQS, Kafka, Pub/Sub, or equivalent technologies.

• Implement reliable asynchronous processing patterns, including retries, idempotency, dead-letter queues, backpressure handling, and fault-tolerant job execution.

AI/ML Integration & Model Workflows

• Lead the development and optimization of metadata extraction, content analysis, scene detection, transcription, embedding generation, and multimodal AI inference workflows.

• Integrate and optimize AI/ML services within backend workflows, including model APIs, embedding pipelines, OCR, speech-to-text, scene analysis, multimodal inference, batching, caching, and fallback strategies.

• Collaborate with ML engineers, data scientists, or external model providers to benchmark models, compare quality/latency trade-offs, and safely roll out model upgrades.

Model Serving & Performance Optimization

• Optimize AI/ML inference workflows for latency, throughput, reliability, and cost across both real-time and batch-processing paths.

• Work with model-serving systems such as vLLM, Triton, TGI, SageMaker, Vertex AI, or custom inference services to improve batching, concurrency, warmup behavior, timeout handling, autoscaling, and GPU utilization.

• Evaluate and apply practical model optimization techniques such as quantization, model distillation, batching, caching, prompt optimization, and routing to smaller or cheaper models where appropriate.

• Design and maintain vector search and indexing systems using technologies such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Elastic Vectors, FAISS, pgvector, or similar tools.

• Build retrieval workflows that support semantic search, similarity matching, duplicate detection, media discovery, and structured metadata search.

• Monitor model and system performance in production, including API latency, queue depth, processing time, model error rates, GPU utilization, confidence distributions, drift signals, and cost per processed item.Search, Indexing & Data Retrieval

Infrastructure, Reliability & Observability

• Deploy and operate systems on AWS, GCP, Azure, or equivalent cloud platforms, including compute, storage, networking, queues, model-serving infrastructure, and monitoring systems.

• Ensure system reliability through logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards, operational runbooks, and incident-response best practices.

Collaboration & Engineering Leadership

• Collaborate with product, design, data, and ML teams to deliver media-rich, AI-powered product features.

• Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, support technical planning, review designs, and raise engineering quality across the team.

• Participate in code reviews, documentation, technical planning, and continuous improvement of engineering practices.

• Ensure code quality through testing, peer review, clear documentation, and maintainable implementation patterns.

Education & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5-7+ years of backend engineering experience, ideally building scalable distributed systems, media platforms, data pipelines, or high-throughput backend services.

• Prior experience owning major backend modules end to end, including architecture, implementation, deployment, monitoring, and production operations.

• 3 + years of experience integrating AI/ML inference systems into backend workflows, including model APIs, embedding pipelines, OCR, speech-to-text, scene detection, or multimodal model outputs.

• Hands-on experience creating AI-powered processing pipelines for image, video, audio, or text analysis.

• Practical experience with production model optimization, especially for image, video, embedding, or multimodal models, including batching, caching, quantization, prompt optimization, routing strategies, latency reduction, and cost optimization.

• Prior experience with vector search, semantic search, media retrieval, or similarity-matching systems is strongly preferred.

• Experience mentoring engineers, leading technical discussions, and influencing architectural decisions across backend, infrastructure, and AI/ML workflows.

Technical Skills

• Strong expertise in Python and/or Node.js with Deep understanding of building scalable RESTful APIs and backend architectures

• Experience with HuggingFace transformers ecosystem and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow.

• Strong experience with SQL/NoSQL databases, schema design, and data modeling

• Preferred Exposure to distributed systems, microservices, asynchronous processing, and event-driven patterns with SQS, Pub/Sub, Kafka, or other queueing/pub-sub systems

• Experience deploying production systems on AWS, GCP, or similar cloud platforms

• Knowledge of infrastructure patterns (compute, storage, networking, observability)

AI/ML Integration

• Experience orchestrating embedding generation, scene detection, OCR, speech-to-text, image classification, video analysis, and multimodal model integrations.

• Experience optimizing inference workflows for latency, throughput, reliability, and cost.

• Experience working with scalable and optimized inference settings, including tuning sampling parameters, managing output‑length formats, and configuring reasoning‑related behaviors.

• Familiarity with practical model optimization techniques such as batching, caching, quantization, model distillation, prompt optimization, fallback routing, and use of smaller models where appropriate.

• Experience working with model-serving systems such as vLLM, Triton, TGI, SageMaker, Vertex AI, or custom inference services is preferred.

• Experience working with LLM and Multi-modal evaluation and benchmarking frameworks and domain‑specific benchmarks with the ability to interpret results and optimize model performance accordingly.

System Design & Architecture

• Preferred understanding of distributed systems, scaling patterns, and performance engineering

• Ability to design modular, maintainable, and efficient architectures

• Experience with API versioning, modularization, and designing long-running workflows

• Understanding of performance bottlenecks and low-latency backend patterns

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Descrizione Unisciti a Tether e Forma il futuro della finanza digitale A Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare senza soluzione di continuità i gettoni di riserva in blockchains. Imbragando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere gettoni digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto ad una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione. Innovare con Tether Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta il più affidabile stablecoin al mondo, USDT, basato su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme ai servizi di tokenizzazione degli asset digitali. Ma questo è solo l’inizio: - Tether Power: Guidare la crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano il potere in eccesso per l'estrazione mineraria di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche eco-friendly nelle strutture all'avanguardia e geo-diverse. - Tether Data: Riduciamo le innovazioni nella tecnologia AI e peer-to-peer, riduciamo i costi delle infrastrutture e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET, la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione di dati sicura e privata. - Tether Education: Democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, forniamo agli individui di prosperare nelle economie digitali e gig, guidando la crescita globale e l'opportunità. - Tether Evolution: All'incrocio tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, realizzando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti. Perché unirsi a noi? - Il nostro team è una centrale di talento globale, che lavora a distanza da ogni angolo del mondo. - Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e fissando nuovi standard. - Siamo cresciuti in fretta, siamo stati magra, e ha assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore. - Se avete eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese e siete pronti a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto per voi. - Sei pronto a far parte del futuro? Riguardo al lavoro Stiamo sviluppando una piattaforma di media intelligence altamente scalabile che elabora, analizza e struttura grandi volumi di contenuti multimediali attraverso testo, immagine, video e audio. In qualità di Senior Applied ML Engineer, potrete progettare e costruire i sistemi di backend core che alimentano l'ingestione dei media, elaborando i flussi di lavoro, la generazione dei metadati, l'analisi basata su AI, la ricerca semantica e il recupero attraverso grandi librerie multimediali. Siamo alla ricerca di un ingegnere ML applicato senior che può progettare, implementare, ottimizzare e valutare una pipeline di moderazione di livello di produzione utilizzando modelli open source. Mansioni - Architetto, costruire e gestire servizi di backend scalabili per una piattaforma di media intelligence, con un focus su sistemi puliti, manutenbili e pronti alla produzione. - I propri componenti di backend critici finiscono alla fine, dalla progettazione del sistema e dai contratti API attraverso l'implementazione, la distribuzione, il monitoraggio e l'iterazione. - Guidare le decisioni architettoniche attraverso API, processi di elaborazione, calcolo distribuito, storage, ricerca, osservanza, infrastruttura cloud e flussi di lavoro di manutenzione dei modelli. - Modelli di dati di progettazione e modelli di archiviazione per i beni multimediali, metadati generati, embeddings, lavori di elaborazione, uscite di modello, indici di ricerca e percorsi di audit. - Progettazione di canali di ingestione e di elaborazione ad alto rendimento per grandi volumi di video, audio, immagine e contenuto di testo. - Costruire flussi di lavoro distribuiti e orientati agli eventi per l'elaborazione dei media utilizzando sistemi di code e pub/sub come SQS, Kafka, Pub/Sub o tecnologie equivalenti. - Implementare modelli di elaborazione asincrono affidabili, tra cui retries, idempotency, code di letter morti, gestione della backpressure e esecuzione di lavoro tollerante. - Condurre lo sviluppo e l'ottimizzazione di metadati di estrazione, analisi dei contenuti, rilevamento della scena, trascrizione, generazione di embedding e flussi di lavoro multimodali di inferenza AI. - Integrare e ottimizzare i servizi AI/ML all'interno dei flussi di lavoro di backend, tra cui le API di modello, le tubazioni di embedding, OCR, il discorso-to-text, l'analisi della scena, l'inferenza multimodale, le strategie di batching, caching e fallback. - Collaborare con gli ingegneri ML, gli scienziati dei dati o i fornitori di modelli esterni ai modelli di riferimento, confrontare i trade-off di qualità/latenza e distribuire in modo sicuro gli aggiornamenti dei modelli. - Distribuire e gestire i sistemi su piattaforme cloud AWS, GCP, Azure o equivalenti, inclusi sistemi di calcolo, storage, networking, code, infrastruttura di monitoraggio e monitoraggio. - Assicurare l'affidabilità del sistema attraverso logging, metriche, tracciamento, allerta, dashboard, runbook operativi e best practice di risposta agli incidenti. - Collaborare con i team di prodotto, design, dati e ML per fornire funzioni di prodotto ricche di media, alimentate con l'intelligenza artificiale. - Mentor junior e mid-level ingegneri, sostenere la pianificazione tecnica, rivedere i progetti e aumentare la qualità dell'ingegneria in tutto il team. - Partecipazione a revisioni di codice, documentazione, pianificazione tecnica e miglioramento continuo delle pratiche ingegneristiche. - Assicurare la qualità del codice attraverso test, peer review, documentazione chiara e modelli di implementazione manutenbili.
• Requisiti - Corso di laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria, o equivalente esperienza pratica. - 5-7 anni di esperienza di backend engineering, la costruzione ideale di sistemi distribuiti scalabili, piattaforme multimediali, datadotti, o servizi di backend ad alto rendimento. - Prima esperienza che possiede i principali moduli di backend finiscono alla fine, tra cui architettura, implementazione, distribuzione, monitoraggio e operazioni di produzione. - 3+ anni di esperienza che integrano i sistemi di inferenza AI/ML nei flussi di lavoro backend, tra cui le API di modello, le pipeline di incorporazione, OCR, discorso-to-text, rilevamento della scena o uscite multimodali modello. - Esperienza pratica nella creazione di condotte di elaborazione alimentate da AI per l'analisi di immagini, video, audio o testo. - Esperienza pratica con ottimizzazione del modello di produzione, in particolare per immagini, video, embedding o modelli multimodali, tra cui batching, caching, quantizzazione, ottimizzazione dei tempi, strategie di routing, riduzione della latenza e ottimizzazione dei costi. - L'esperienza precedente con la ricerca vettoriale, la ricerca semantica, il recupero dei mezzi di comunicazione, o i sistemi di corrispondenza di somiglianza è fortemente preferito. - Esperienza di ingegneri di mentoring, principali discussioni tecniche, e influenzare le decisioni architettoniche attraverso backend, infrastrutture e flussi di lavoro AI/ML. Competenze tecniche - Forte competenza in Python e/o Node.js con profonda comprensione della costruzione di API RESTful scalabili e architetture backend - Esperienza con i trasformatori HuggingFace ecosistema e strutture di apprendimento profonde come PyTorch e TensorFlow. - Forte esperienza con database SQL/NoSQL, progettazione degli schemi e modellazione dei dati - Preferito Esposizione a sistemi distribuiti, microservizi, elaborazione asincrona e modelli orientati agli eventi con sistemi SQS, Pub/Sub, Kafka o altri sistemi di code/pub-sub - Esperienza nell'implementazione di sistemi di produzione su piattaforme cloud AWS, GCP o simili - Conoscenza dei modelli di infrastruttura (compute, storage, networking, osservabilità) - Esperienza orchestrante generazione di embedding, rilevamento della scena, OCR, discorso-to-text, classificazione delle immagini, analisi video e integrazioni di modelli multimodali. - Esperienza ottimizzando i flussi di lavoro di inferenza per la latenza, il throughput, l'affidabilità e i costi. - Esperienza di lavoro con impostazioni di inferenza scalabili e ottimizzate, compresi i parametri di campionamento di tuning, la gestione dei formati di lunghezza d'uscita e la configurazione dei comportamenti correlati al ragionamento. - Familiarità con tecniche di ottimizzazione di modelli pratici come batching, caching, quantizzazione, distillazione di modelli, ottimizzazione rapida, routing di fallback, e l'uso di modelli più piccoli, se del caso. - L'esperienza di lavoro con sistemi di manutenzione dei modelli come vLLM, Triton, TGI, SageMaker, Vertex AI, o servizi di inferenza personalizzati è preferito. - Esperienza di lavoro con LLM e Multi-modal framework di valutazione e benchmarking e benchmark specifici di dominio con la capacità di interpretare i risultati e ottimizzare le prestazioni del modello di conseguenza. - Preferita comprensione di sistemi distribuiti, modelli di scala e ingegneria delle prestazioni - Capacità di progettare architetture modulari, manutenbili ed efficienti - Esperienza con la versione API, la modularizzazione e la progettazione di flussi di lavoro lunghi - Comprensione dei colli di bottiglia delle prestazioni e dei modelli backend a bassa latenza Cosa? - L'opportunità di lavorare su sistemi AI/ML all'avanguardia in un ambiente fintech veloce e innovativo. - Collaborazione con talento globale e leader del settore in blockchain e AI. - Una cultura remota che valorizza flessibilità, autonomia e equilibrio di vita lavorativa. - Compensazione e pacchetto benefici. - La possibilità di plasmare il futuro della finanza digitale e dell'intelligenza media alimentata dall'IA. Importanti informazioni per i candidati Le truffe di reclutamento sono diventate sempre più comuni. Per proteggersi, si prega di tenere a mente il seguente quando si applica per i ruoli: - Applicare solo attraverso i nostri canali ufficiali. Non utilizziamo piattaforme o agenzie di terze parti per il reclutamento, a meno che non sia chiaro. Tutti i ruoli aperti sono elencati nella nostra pagina di carriera ufficiale: https://tether.recruitee.com/ - Verificare l’identità del reclutatore. Tutti i nostri reclutatori hanno verificato i profili LinkedIn. Se non sei sicuro, puoi confermare la loro identità controllando il loro profilo o contattandoci attraverso il nostro sito web. - Sii prudente di metodi di comunicazione insoliti. Non conduciamo interviste su WhatsApp, Telegram o SMS. Tutte le comunicazioni vengono effettuate tramite e-mail e piattaforme aziendali ufficiali. - Doppio indirizzo email. Tutte le comunicazioni da noi verranno da e-mail che terminano in @tether.to o @tether.io - Non chiederemo mai il pagamento o i dettagli finanziari. Se qualcuno chiede informazioni finanziarie personali o il pagamento in qualsiasi momento durante il processo di assunzione, è una truffa. Si prega di segnalare immediatamente. Quando in dubbio, non esitate a raggiungere il nostro sito ufficiale.

• Drive architectural decisions across APIs, processing pipelines, distributed compute, storage, search, observability, cloud infrastructure, and model-serving workflows.

• Design data models and storage patterns for media assets, generated metadata, embeddings, processing jobs, model outputs, search indexes, and audit trails.

• Design high-throughput media ingestion and processing pipelines for large volumes of video, audio, image, and text content.

• Build distributed, event-driven workflows for media processing using queues and pub/sub systems such as SQS, Kafka, Pub/Sub, or equivalent technologies.

• Implement reliable asynchronous processing patterns, including retries, idempotency, dead-letter queues, backpressure handling, and fault-tolerant job execution.

AI/ML Integration & Model Workflows

• Lead the development and optimization of metadata extraction, content analysis, scene detection, transcription, embedding generation, and multimodal AI inference workflows.

• Integrate and optimize AI/ML services within backend workflows, including model APIs, embedding pipelines, OCR, speech-to-text, scene analysis, multimodal inference, batching, caching, and fallback strategies.

• Collaborate with ML engineers, data scientists, or external model providers to benchmark models, compare quality/latency trade-offs, and safely roll out model upgrades.

Model Serving & Performance Optimization

• Optimize AI/ML inference workflows for latency, throughput, reliability, and cost across both real-time and batch-processing paths.

• Work with model-serving systems such as vLLM, Triton, TGI, SageMaker, Vertex AI, or custom inference services to improve batching, concurrency, warmup behavior, timeout handling, autoscaling, and GPU utilization.

• Evaluate and apply practical model optimization techniques such as quantization, model distillation, batching, caching, prompt optimization, and routing to smaller or cheaper models where appropriate.

• Design and maintain vector search and indexing systems using technologies such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Elastic Vectors, FAISS, pgvector, or similar tools.

• Build retrieval workflows that support semantic search, similarity matching, duplicate detection, media discovery, and structured metadata search.

• Monitor model and system performance in production, including API latency, queue depth, processing time, model error rates, GPU utilization, confidence distributions, drift signals, and cost per processed item.Search, Indexing & Data Retrieval

Infrastructure, Reliability & Observability

• Deploy and operate systems on AWS, GCP, Azure, or equivalent cloud platforms, including compute, storage, networking, queues, model-serving infrastructure, and monitoring systems.

• Ensure system reliability through logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards, operational runbooks, and incident-response best practices.

Collaboration & Engineering Leadership

• Collaborate with product, design, data, and ML teams to deliver media-rich, AI-powered product features.

• Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, support technical planning, review designs, and raise engineering quality across the team.

• Participate in code reviews, documentation, technical planning, and continuous improvement of engineering practices.

• Ensure code quality through testing, peer review, clear documentation, and maintainable implementation patterns.

Education & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5-7+ years of backend engineering experience, ideally building scalable distributed systems, media platforms, data pipelines, or high-throughput backend services.

• Prior experience owning major backend modules end to end, including architecture, implementation, deployment, monitoring, and production operations.

• 3 + years of experience integrating AI/ML inference systems into backend workflows, including model APIs, embedding pipelines, OCR, speech-to-text, scene detection, or multimodal model outputs.

• Hands-on experience creating AI-powered processing pipelines for image, video, audio, or text analysis.

• Practical experience with production model optimization, especially for image, video, embedding, or multimodal models, including batching, caching, quantization, prompt optimization, routing strategies, latency reduction, and cost optimization.

• Prior experience with vector search, semantic search, media retrieval, or similarity-matching systems is strongly preferred.

• Experience mentoring engineers, leading technical discussions, and influencing architectural decisions across backend, infrastructure, and AI/ML workflows.

Technical Skills

• Strong expertise in Python and/or Node.js with Deep understanding of building scalable RESTful APIs and backend architectures

• Experience with HuggingFace transformers ecosystem and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow.

• Strong experience with SQL/NoSQL databases, schema design, and data modeling

• Preferred Exposure to distributed systems, microservices, asynchronous processing, and event-driven patterns with SQS, Pub/Sub, Kafka, or other queueing/pub-sub systems

• Experience deploying production systems on AWS, GCP, or similar cloud platforms

• Knowledge of infrastructure patterns (compute, storage, networking, observability)

AI/ML Integration

• Experience orchestrating embedding generation, scene detection, OCR, speech-to-text, image classification, video analysis, and multimodal model integrations.

• Experience optimizing inference workflows for latency, throughput, reliability, and cost.

• Experience working with scalable and optimized inference settings, including tuning sampling parameters, managing output‑length formats, and configuring reasoning‑related behaviors.

• Familiarity with practical model optimization techniques such as batching, caching, quantization, model distillation, prompt optimization, fallback routing, and use of smaller models where appropriate.

• Experience working with model-serving systems such as vLLM, Triton, TGI, SageMaker, Vertex AI, or custom inference services is preferred.

• Experience working with LLM and Multi-modal evaluation and benchmarking frameworks and domain‑specific benchmarks with the ability to interpret results and optimize model performance accordingly.

System Design & Architecture

• Preferred understanding of distributed systems, scaling patterns, and performance engineering

• Ability to design modular, maintainable, and efficient architectures

• Experience with API versioning, modularization, and designing long-running workflows

• Understanding of performance bottlenecks and low-latency backend patterns

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises (des bourses et portefeuilles aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques) d'intégrer de manière transparente les jetons adossés à des réserves dans les blockchains. À propos du poste Nous développons une plate-forme d'intelligence médiatique hautement évolutive qui traite, analyse et structure de grands volumes de contenu multimédia à travers le texte, l'image, la vidéo et l'audio. En tant qu'ingénieur senior en ML appliqué, vous concevrez et construirez les principaux systèmes backend qui alimentent l'ingestion de médias, les flux de travail de traitement, la génération de métadonnées, l'analyse basée sur l'IA, la recherche sémantique et la récupération dans de grandes bibliothèques multimédias. Nous recherchons un ingénieur senior en ML appliqué capable de concevoir, de mettre en œuvre, d'optimiser et d'évaluer un pipeline de modération de niveau production à l'aide de modèles open source. Mansioni – Construisez, créez et exploitez des services backend évolutifs pour une plate-forme d'intelligence médiatique, en mettant l'accent sur des systèmes propres, maintenables et prêts pour la production. - Posséder les composants back-end critiques de bout en bout, depuis la conception du système et les contrats d'API jusqu'à la mise en œuvre, le déploiement, la surveillance et l'itération. - Pilotez les décisions architecturales concernant les API, les pipelines de traitement, le calcul distribué, le stockage, la recherche, l'observabilité, l'infrastructure cloud et les workflows de diffusion de modèles. - Concevoir des modèles de données et des modèles de stockage pour les ressources multimédias, les métadonnées générées, les intégrations, les tâches de traitement, les sorties de modèles, les index de recherche et les pistes d'audit. - Concevoir des pipelines d'ingestion et de traitement multimédia à haut débit pour de grands volumes de contenu vidéo, audio, image et texte. - Créez des flux de travail distribués et pilotés par événements pour le traitement des médias à l'aide de files d'attente et de systèmes pub/sub tels que SQS, Kafka, Pub/Sub ou des technologies équivalentes. - Implémentez des modèles de traitement asynchrone fiables, notamment les tentatives, l'idempotence, les files d'attente de lettres mortes, la gestion des contre-pressions et l'exécution des tâches tolérantes aux pannes. - Diriger le développement et l'optimisation des flux de travail d'extraction de métadonnées, d'analyse de contenu, de détection de scènes, de transcription, de génération d'intégration et d'inférence multimodale d'IA. - Intégrez et optimisez les services IA/ML dans les flux de travail backend, y compris les API de modèle, l'intégration de pipelines, l'OCR, la synthèse vocale, l'analyse de scène, l'inférence multimodale, le traitement par lots, la mise en cache et les stratégies de repli. - Collaborez avec des ingénieurs ML, des data scientists ou des fournisseurs de modèles externes pour comparer les modèles, comparer les compromis qualité/latence et déployer en toute sécurité les mises à niveau des modèles. - Déployez et exploitez des systèmes sur AWS, GCP, Azure ou des plates-formes cloud équivalentes, y compris le calcul, le stockage, la mise en réseau, les files d'attente, l'infrastructure de service de modèles et les systèmes de surveillance. - Collaborer avec les équipes produit, conception, données et ML pour fournir des fonctionnalités de produit riches en médias et basées sur l'IA. - Encadrer les ingénieurs juniors et intermédiaires, soutenir la planification technique, réviser les conceptions et améliorer la qualité de l'ingénierie au sein de l'équipe. - Participer aux révisions de code, à la documentation, à la planification technique et à l'amélioration continue des pratiques d'ingénierie. - Garantir la qualité du code grâce à des tests, un examen par les pairs, une documentation claire et des modèles de mise en œuvre maintenables.
• Requisiti - Baccalauréat en informatique, en ingénierie ou expérience pratique équivalente. - 5 à 7+ années d'expérience en ingénierie back-end, idéalement dans la création de systèmes distribués évolutifs, de plates-formes multimédias, de pipelines de données ou de services back-end à haut débit. - Expérience préalable dans la possession des principaux modules backend de bout en bout, y compris les opérations d'architecture, de mise en œuvre, de déploiement, de surveillance et de production. - Plus de 3 ans d'expérience dans l'intégration de systèmes d'inférence IA/ML dans des flux de travail backend, y compris des API de modèle, l'intégration de pipelines, l'OCR, la parole en texte, la détection de scène ou les sorties de modèles multimodaux. - Expérience pratique dans la création de pipelines de traitement basés sur l'IA pour l'analyse d'images, de vidéos, d'audio ou de texte. - Expérience pratique de l'optimisation des modèles de production, en particulier pour les modèles d'image, de vidéo, d'intégration ou multimodaux, y compris le traitement par lots, la mise en cache, la quantification, l'optimisation rapide, les stratégies de routage, la réduction de la latence et l'optimisation des coûts. - Une expérience préalable en matière de recherche vectorielle, de recherche sémantique, de récupération multimédia ou de systèmes de correspondance de similarité est fortement préférée. - Expérience dans le mentorat d'ingénieurs, dans la direction de discussions techniques et dans l'influence des décisions architecturales dans les workflows backend, d'infrastructure et d'IA/ML. Compétence technique - Forte expertise en Python et/ou Node.js avec une compréhension approfondie de la création d'API RESTful et d'architectures backend évolutives - Expérience avec l'écosystème des transformateurs HuggingFace et les cadres d'apprentissage en profondeur tels que PyTorch et TensorFlow. - Solide expérience avec les bases de données SQL/NoSQL, la conception de schémas et la modélisation de données - Exposition privilégiée aux systèmes distribués, aux microservices, au traitement asynchrone et aux modèles pilotés par les événements avec SQS, Pub/Sub, Kafka ou d'autres systèmes de file d'attente/pub-sub - Expérience dans le déploiement de systèmes de production sur AWS, GCP ou des plates-formes cloud similaires - Connaissance des modèles d'infrastructure (calcul, stockage, réseau, observabilité) - Expérience dans l'orchestration de la génération d'intégration, de la détection de scènes, de l'OCR, synthèse vocale, classification d'images, analyse vidéo et intégrations de modèles multimodaux. - Expérience dans l'optimisation des flux de travail d'inférence en termes de latence, de débit, de fiabilité et de coût. - Expérience de travail avec des paramètres d'inférence évolutifs et optimisés, y compris le réglage des paramètres d'échantillonnage, la gestion des formats de longueur de sortie et la configuration des comportements liés au raisonnement. - Familiarité avec les techniques pratiques d'optimisation de modèles telles que le traitement par lots, la mise en cache, la quantification, la distillation de modèles, l'optimisation rapide, le routage de secours et l'utilisation de modèles plus petits, le cas échéant. - Une expérience de travail avec des systèmes de diffusion de modèles tels que vLLM, Triton, TGI, SageMaker, Vertex AI ou des services d'inférence personnalisés est préférable. - Expérience de travail avec des cadres d'évaluation et d'analyse comparative LLM et multimodaux et des références spécifiques à un domaine avec la capacité d'interpréter les résultats et d'optimiser les performances du modèle en conséquence. - Compréhension préférée des systèmes distribués, des modèles de mise à l'échelle et de l'ingénierie des performances - Capacité à concevoir des architectures modulaires, maintenables et efficaces - Expérience en matière de versionnage, de modularisation et de conception d'API de flux de travail à long terme - Compréhension des goulots d'étranglement en matière de performances et des modèles backend à faible latence
• Cosa offriamo - L'opportunité de travailler sur des systèmes IA/ML de pointe dans un environnement fintech innovant et en évolution rapide. - Collaboration avec des talents mondiaux et des leaders de l'industrie de la blockchain et de l'IA. - Une culture du télétravail qui valorise la flexibilité, l'autonomie et l'équilibre travail-vie personnelle. - Rémunération et avantages sociaux compétitifs. - L'opportunité de façonner l'avenir de la finance numérique et de l'intelligence médiatique basée sur l'IA. Informations importantes pour les candidats Les escroqueries au recrutement sont devenues de plus en plus courantes. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder les points suivants à l'esprit lorsque vous postulez à des postes : - Postulez uniquement via nos canaux officiels. Nous n'utilisons pas de plateformes ou d'agences tierces pour le recrutement, sauf indication contraire. Tous les postes ouverts sont répertoriés sur notre page officielle des carrières : https://tether.recruitee.com/ - Vérifiez l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont des profils LinkedIn vérifiés. En cas de doute, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en vérifiant leur profil ou en nous contactant via notre site Web. - Méfiez-vous des méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous ne menons pas d'entretiens par WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toutes les communications se font via les e-mails et les plateformes officielles de l'entreprise. - Vérifiez les adresses e-mail. Toutes les communications de notre part proviendront d'e-mails se terminant par @tether.to ou @tether.io - Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. Si quelqu’un demande des informations financières personnelles ou un paiement à tout moment du processus d’embauche, il s’agit d’une arnaque. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement. En cas de doute, n'hésitez pas à nous contacter via notre site officiel.

jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 We are looking for a precision-driven Global Events Financial Controller to serve as the fiscal engine of our Global Events department. In this role, you will be the primary lead for the entire financial lifecycle of our international events—from the first vendor quotation to the final payment and yearly budget reconciliation.

Responsibilities

• Consolidate quotations

• Elaborate budgets, tracking and reports and real-time financial clarity to the Events Team

• Contracts signature process

• Invoicing and payment process

• Multi-currency & multi-company reconciliations

• Post events reports

Requirements

• Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, or Business Administration.

• 5+ years of experience in accounting of Events, Travel, or Hospitality industry.

• Advanced Excel skills (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables) and Power Point.

• Language: Full professional proficiency or Native in English & Spanish. Italian is a plus.

• Soft Skills: High attention to detail and strong negotiation skills for vendor quotations. Organization skills.

• Some traveling availability might be required

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

About the job
 The goal of a Senior QA Engineer is to ensure product quality, reliability, and an exceptional user experience through a balanced combination of manual and automated testing. This involves designing and executing comprehensive test cases, performing exploratory and regression testing, identifying and documenting defects, and ensuring issues are properly tracked and resolved.

Senior QA Engineers also develop and maintain scalable automation frameworks, integrating them into continuous integration and delivery pipelines to achieve broad coverage across functional, regression, and performance scenarios. By continuously improving testing efficiency and reducing manual effort, they help accelerate release cycles without compromising quality.

Focused on preventing defects from reaching end users, Senior QA Engineers collaborate closely with development teams to uphold high standards of usability, performance, and reliability, blending the depth of manual validation with the speed and consistency of automation to deliver a seamless and dependable product experience.

Responsibilities

• Design and Execute Test Cases : Create detailed, well-structured test plans and cases based on product requirements and acceptance criteria.

• Conduct Exploratory Testing : Investigate the application beyond scripted cases to identify edge cases, usability issues, and unexpected behavior.

• Identify and Document Defects : Accurately record issues with clear steps to reproduce, expected vs. actual results, and relevant evidence (screenshots, logs).

• Collaborate with Development Teams : Work closely with developers, product managers, and designers to clarify requirements and discuss quality concerns.

• Validate Bug Fixes : Re-test resolved defects to confirm they are fully fixed and do not introduce new issues.

• Design and Develop Automated Test Cases : Build, maintain, and optimize automated test scripts based on product requirements and acceptance criteria.

• Create and Maintain Test Automation Frameworks : Develop scalable, reusable, and maintainable test automation frameworks that support functional, regression, and performance testing.

• Integrate Automation into CI/CD Pipelines : Collaborate with DevOps and development teams to embed automated tests into continuous integration and delivery workflows.

• Execute Automated Functional Testing : Run automated test suites to validate that each feature works as expected and meets quality standards.

• Monitor and Analyze Test Results : Investigate test failures, identify root causes, and work with development teams to resolve defects.

Mandatory

• Education : Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

• Experience:

• 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, including both manual and automation testing.

• Demonstrated experience defining and executing QA strategies for complex software systems.

• 3+ years of experience in JavaScript, Typescript & NodeJS

• 3+ years of experience in test automation design and implementation (e.g., using Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or equivalent).

• 3+ years of experience in native mobile test automation design and implementation (e.g. Appium, Espresso, XCUITest, Detox, AWS Device Farm, BrowserStack App Automate, Firebase Test Lab, Sauce Labs, Kobiton, Robot Framework, BitBar, LambdaTest Mobile, HeadSpin, Fastlane, Tricentis Testim or equivalent)

• Expertise in defining and implementing test plans, automation frameworks, and quality metrics.

• Strong collaborative skills to align testing efforts with Development, DevOps, and Product Management.

• Ability to critically evaluate requirements for quality, ensuring clarity, testability, and completeness.

• Demonstrated ability to identify release risks, escalate concerns, and recommend no-go decisions when quality standards or release criteria are not met.

• Technical Knowledge :

• Strong understanding of QA methodologies, test design techniques, and SDLC/Agile/Scrum practices.

• Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).

• Proven experience integrating automated tests into build and deployment workflows.

• Proficiency in QA and defect tracking tools (e.g., TestPad, Qase, TestRail, Jira, Asana, Confluence).

• Soft Skills :

• Strong communication, and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Strong self-organisational skills and adaptability. Working effectively in agile and fast-paced environments, and adjusting to changing priorities, requirements and delivery timelines.

• Language : Proficiency in English (spoken and written).

Preferred

About the job
The goal of a Senior QA Engineer is to ensure product quality, reliability, and an exceptional user experience through a balanced combination of manual and automated testing. This involves designing and executing comprehensive test cases, performing exploratory and regression testing, identifying and documenting defects, and ensuring issues are properly tracked and resolved.

Senior QA Engineers also develop and maintain scalable automation frameworks, integrating them into continuous integration and delivery pipelines to achieve broad coverage across functional, regression, and performance scenarios. By continuously improving testing efficiency and reducing manual effort, they help accelerate release cycles without compromising quality.

Focused on preventing defects from reaching end users, Senior QA Engineers collaborate closely with development teams to uphold high standards of usability, performance, and reliability, blending the depth of manual validation with the speed and consistency of automation to deliver a seamless and dependable product experience.

Responsibilities

• Design and Execute Test Cases : Create detailed, well-structured test plans and cases based on product requirements and acceptance criteria.

• Conduct Exploratory Testing : Investigate the application beyond scripted cases to identify edge cases, usability issues, and unexpected behavior.

• Identify and Document Defects : Accurately record issues with clear steps to reproduce, expected vs. actual results, and relevant evidence (screenshots, logs).

• Collaborate with Development Teams : Work closely with developers, product managers, and designers to clarify requirements and discuss quality concerns.

• Validate Bug Fixes : Re-test resolved defects to confirm they are fully fixed and do not introduce new issues.

• Design and Develop Automated Test Cases : Build, maintain, and optimize automated test scripts based on product requirements and acceptance criteria.

• Create and Maintain Test Automation Frameworks : Develop scalable, reusable, and maintainable test automation frameworks that support functional, regression, and performance testing.

• Integrate Automation into CI/CD Pipelines : Collaborate with DevOps and development teams to embed automated tests into continuous integration and delivery workflows.

• Execute Automated Functional Testing : Run automated test suites to validate that each feature works as expected and meets quality standards.

• Monitor and Analyze Test Results : Investigate test failures, identify root causes, and work with development teams to resolve defects.

Mandatory

• Education : Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

• Experience:

• 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, including both manual and automation testing.

• Demonstrated experience defining and executing QA strategies for complex software systems.

• 3+ years of experience in JavaScript, Typescript & NodeJS

• 3+ years of experience in test automation design and implementation (e.g., using Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or equivalent).

• 3+ years of experience in native mobile test automation design and implementation (e.g. Appium, Espresso, XCUITest, Detox, AWS Device Farm, BrowserStack App Automate, Firebase Test Lab, Sauce Labs, Kobiton, Robot Framework, BitBar, LambdaTest Mobile, HeadSpin, Fastlane, Tricentis Testim or equivalent)

• Expertise in defining and implementing test plans, automation frameworks, and quality metrics.

• Strong collaborative skills to align testing efforts with Development, DevOps, and Product Management.

• Ability to critically evaluate requirements for quality, ensuring clarity, testability, and completeness.

• Demonstrated ability to identify release risks, escalate concerns, and recommend no-go decisions when quality standards or release criteria are not met.

• Technical Knowledge :

• Strong understanding of QA methodologies, test design techniques, and SDLC/Agile/Scrum practices.

• Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).

• Proven experience integrating automated tests into build and deployment workflows.

• Proficiency in QA and defect tracking tools (e.g., TestPad, Qase, TestRail, Jira, Asana, Confluence).

• Soft Skills :

• Strong communication, and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Strong self-organisational skills and adaptability. Working effectively in agile and fast-paced environments, and adjusting to changing priorities, requirements and delivery timelines.

• Language : Proficiency in English (spoken and written).

Preferred

• Certifications : ISTQB Advanced Level or equivalent QA certification.

• Knowledge of database systems (SQL, NoSQL) and API testing tools (e.g., Postman, Newman, REST Assured).

• Understanding of system architecture and software integration testing.

• Familiarity with performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, k6, Gatling).

• Understanding of cybersecurity principles and secure software testing practices.

• Experience with test data management and environment configuration.

• Knowledge of performance, load, and security testing principles.
