Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises, depuis les échanges et les portefeuilles jusqu'aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques de billets, d'intégrer de façon transparente les jetons à l'aide de réserves dans toutes les chaînes de blocs. En exploitant la puissance de la technologie blockchain, Tether vous permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, en toute sécurité et globalement, le tout à une fraction du coût. La transparence est le fondement de tout ce que nous faisons, assurant la confiance dans chaque transaction. Innovez avec Tether Tether Finance: Notre suite de produits innovants dispose de la plus fiable écurie du monde, USDT , sur laquelle s'appuient des centaines de millions de monde, ainsi que des services de tokenisation d'actifs numériques pionniers. Mais ce n'est que le début : Tether Power : Pour une croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l'excès de puissance pour l'exploitation minière Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques écologiques dans des installations géo-diverses à la fine pointe de la technologie. Tether Data: En alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie pair à pair, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET , notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé. Tether Education : Démocratiser l'accès à l'apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous autonomisons les individus à prospérer dans les économies numériques et de concerts, moteur de la croissance mondiale et des opportunités. L'évolution de l'approche : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, écrivant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Notre équipe est une puissance mondiale de talents, travaillant à distance de tous les coins du monde. Si vous êtes passionné par la marque dans l'espace fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les frontières et de fixer de nouvelles normes. Nous avons grandi rapidement, sommes restés maigres et nous avons obtenu notre place de leader dans l'industrie. Si vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication anglaise et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est l'endroit pour vous. Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ? Mansioni L'objectif d'un ingénieur principal de l'AQ est d'assurer la qualité du produit, la fiabilité et une expérience utilisateur exceptionnelle grâce à une combinaison équilibrée de tests manuels et automatisés. Il s'agit de concevoir et d'exécuter des cas d'essai exhaustifs, d'effectuer des essais exploratoires et de régression, d'identifier et de documenter les défauts et de s'assurer que les problèmes sont adéquatement suivis et résolus. Les ingénieurs principaux de l'AQ élaborent et maintiennent également des cadres d'automatisation évolutives, les intégrant dans des pipelines d'intégration et de livraison continues afin d'assurer une large couverture des scénarios fonctionnels, de régression et de rendement. En améliorant continuellement l'efficacité des tests et en réduisant l'effort manuel, ils contribuent à accélérer les cycles de libération sans compromettre la qualité. Concentré sur la prévention des défauts pour atteindre les utilisateurs finaux, Senior QA Engineers collabore étroitement avec les équipes de développement pour maintenir des normes élevées d'utilisation, de performance et de fiabilité, en combinant la profondeur de la validation manuelle avec la rapidité et la cohérence de l'automatisation pour offrir une expérience de produit transparente et fiable. Responsabilità - Design and Execute Test Cases : Créez des plans d'essais détaillés et bien structurés et des cas basés sur les exigences du produit et les critères d'acceptation. - Conduct Exploratory Testing : Étudier l'application au-delà des cas scénarisés pour identifier les cas bord, les problèmes d'utilisation et le comportement inattendu. - Identifier et documenter les défauts : enregistrer avec précision les problèmes avec des étapes claires pour reproduire, les résultats attendus vs. réels, et les preuves pertinentes (screenshots, journaux). - Collaborer avec les équipes de développement : Collaborer étroitement avec les développeurs, les gestionnaires de produits et les concepteurs pour clarifier les exigences et discuter des préoccupations de qualité. - Valider les corrections de bogues : Re-test résolu les défauts pour confirmer qu'ils sont entièrement corrigés et ne pas introduire de nouveaux problèmes. - Conception et développement de boîtiers d'essai automatisés : Construisez, maintenez et optimisez des scripts d'essai automatisés en fonction des exigences du produit et des critères d'acceptation. - Créer et maintenir des cadres d'automatisation des essais : Développer des cadres d'automatisation des essais évolutives, réutilisables et durables qui soutiennent les tests fonctionnels, de régression et de performance. - Intégrer l'automatisation dans les pipelines CI/CD : Collaborer avec DevOps et les équipes de développement pour intégrer les tests automatisés dans les flux de travail continus d'intégration et de livraison. - Exécuter des tests fonctionnels automatisés : Exécuter des tests automatisés pour valider que chaque fonction fonctionne comme prévu et répond aux normes de qualité. - Surveiller et analyser les résultats des tests : Étudier les échecs des tests, identifier les causes profondes et travailler avec les équipes de développement pour résoudre les défauts.
• Requisiti Obligatoire - Éducation : Baccalauréat en informatique, technologie de l'information, génie, ou un domaine connexe (ou expérience pratique équivalente). - Expérience : - 5 ans et plus d'expérience en assurance qualité, y compris les tests manuels et d'automatisation. - Expérience démontrée définissant et exécutant des stratégies d'AQ pour des systèmes logiciels complexes. - 3+ ans d'expérience en JavaScript, Typescript & NodeJS - 3+ ans d'expérience dans la conception et la mise en œuvre de tests d'automatisation (par exemple, en utilisant Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, ou équivalent). - 3 ans et plus d'expérience dans la conception et la mise en œuvre d'automatisations de tests mobiles natives (par exemple Appium, Espresso, XCUITest, Detox, AWS Device Farm, BrowserStack App Automate, Firebase Test Lab, Sauce Labs, Kobiton, Robot Framework, BitBar, LambdaTest Mobile, HeadSpin, Fastlane, Tricentis Testim ou équivalent) - Expertise dans la définition et la mise en oeuvre de plans de tests, de cadres d'automatisation et de mesures de qualité. - Fortes compétences en collaboration pour aligner les efforts de test sur le développement, les DevOps et la gestion des produits. - Capacité d'évaluer de façon critique les exigences de qualité, en assurant la clarté, la testabilité et l'exhaustivité. - Capacité démontrée de déterminer les risques de libération, d'accroître les préoccupations et de recommander des décisions d'exclusion lorsque les normes de qualité ou les critères de libération ne sont pas respectés. - Connaissances techniques : - Bonne compréhension des méthodologies d'AQ, des techniques de conception des essais et des pratiques SDLC/Agile/Scrum. - Expérience pratique des pipelines CI/CD et des pratiques DevOps (p. ex., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI). - Expérience éprouvée intégrant des tests automatisés dans les flux de travail de construction et de déploiement. - Compétence en QA et en outils de repérage des défauts (p. ex. TestPad, Qase, TestRail, Jira, Asana, Confluence). - Compétences souples : - Compétences solides en communication et en gestion des intervenants. - Fortes capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes. - Fortes compétences auto-organisationnelles et adaptabilité. Travailler efficacement dans des environnements agiles et rapides, et s'adapter à l'évolution des priorités, des exigences et des délais de livraison. - Langue : Connaissance de l'anglais (parlé et écrit). Preferred - Certifications : Niveau avancé ISTQB ou certification QA équivalente. - Connaissance des systèmes de base de données (SQL, NoSQL) et des outils d'analyse des API (p. ex. Postman, Newman, REST Assuré). - Compréhension de l'architecture du système et des tests d'intégration des logiciels. - Familiarité avec les outils de test de performance (par exemple, JMeter, k6, Gatling). - Compréhension des principes de cybersécurité et des pratiques d'essai des logiciels sécurisés. - Expérience de la gestion des données de test et de la configuration de l'environnement. - Connaissance des principes de performance, de charge et de sécurité. Contatto Les escroqueries de recrutement sont devenues de plus en plus fréquentes. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder à l'esprit ce qui suit lorsque vous postulez pour des rôles : - Appliquer uniquement par le biais de nos canaux officiels. Nous n'utilisons pas de plates-formes ou d'agences tierces pour le recrutement à moins d'indication claire. Tous les rôles ouverts sont listés sur notre page de carrière officielle : https://tether.recruitee.com/ - Vérifier l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont vérifié les profils LinkedIn. Si vous n'êtes pas sûr, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en vérifiant leur profil ou en nous contactant via notre site Web. - Oui. Méfiez-vous des méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous ne menons pas d'entrevues sur WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toute communication se fait au moyen de courriels et de plateformes officiels de l'entreprise. - Vérifiez les adresses e-mail. Toute communication de nous viendra de courriels se terminant par @ tether.to ou @ sether. io - Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. Si quelqu'un demande des renseignements financiers personnels ou un paiement à tout moment pendant le processus d'embauche, c'est une escroquerie. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement. En cas de doute, n'hésitez pas à contacter notre site officiel.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 The goal of a Senior QA Engineer is to ensure product quality, reliability, and an exceptional user experience through a balanced combination of manual and automated testing. This involves designing and executing comprehensive test cases, performing exploratory and regression testing, identifying and documenting defects, and ensuring issues are properly tracked and resolved.

Senior QA Engineers also develop and maintain scalable automation frameworks, integrating them into continuous integration and delivery pipelines to achieve broad coverage across functional, regression, and performance scenarios. By continuously improving testing efficiency and reducing manual effort, they help accelerate release cycles without compromising quality.

Focused on preventing defects from reaching end users, Senior QA Engineers collaborate closely with development teams to uphold high standards of usability, performance, and reliability, blending the depth of manual validation with the speed and consistency of automation to deliver a seamless and dependable product experience.

Responsibilities

• Design and Execute Test Cases : Create detailed, well-structured test plans and cases based on product requirements and acceptance criteria.

• Conduct Exploratory Testing : Investigate the application beyond scripted cases to identify edge cases, usability issues, and unexpected behavior.

• Identify and Document Defects : Accurately record issues with clear steps to reproduce, expected vs. actual results, and relevant evidence (screenshots, logs).

• Collaborate with Development Teams : Work closely with developers, product managers, and designers to clarify requirements and discuss quality concerns.

• Validate Bug Fixes : Re-test resolved defects to confirm they are fully fixed and do not introduce new issues.

• Design and Develop Automated Test Cases : Build, maintain, and optimize automated test scripts based on product requirements and acceptance criteria.

• Create and Maintain Test Automation Frameworks : Develop scalable, reusable, and maintainable test automation frameworks that support functional, regression, and performance testing.

• Integrate Automation into CI/CD Pipelines : Collaborate with DevOps and development teams to embed automated tests into continuous integration and delivery workflows.

• Execute Automated Functional Testing : Run automated test suites to validate that each feature works as expected and meets quality standards.

• Monitor and Analyze Test Results : Investigate test failures, identify root causes, and work with development teams to resolve defects.

Mandatory

• Education : Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

• Experience:

• 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, including both manual and automation testing.

• Demonstrated experience defining and executing QA strategies for complex software systems.

• 3+ years of experience in JavaScript, Typescript & NodeJS

• 3+ years of experience in test automation design and implementation (e.g., using Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or equivalent).

• 3+ years of experience in native mobile test automation design and implementation (e.g. Appium, Espresso, XCUITest, Detox, AWS Device Farm, BrowserStack App Automate, Firebase Test Lab, Sauce Labs, Kobiton, Robot Framework, BitBar, LambdaTest Mobile, HeadSpin, Fastlane, Tricentis Testim or equivalent)

• Expertise in defining and implementing test plans, automation frameworks, and quality metrics.

• Strong collaborative skills to align testing efforts with Development, DevOps, and Product Management.

• Ability to critically evaluate requirements for quality, ensuring clarity, testability, and completeness.

• Demonstrated ability to identify release risks, escalate concerns, and recommend no-go decisions when quality standards or release criteria are not met.

• Technical Knowledge :

• Strong understanding of QA methodologies, test design techniques, and SDLC/Agile/Scrum practices.

• Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).

• Proven experience integrating automated tests into build and deployment workflows.

• Proficiency in QA and defect tracking tools (e.g., TestPad, Qase, TestRail, Jira, Asana, Confluence).

• Soft Skills :

• Strong communication, and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Strong self-organisational skills and adaptability. Working effectively in agile and fast-paced environments, and adjusting to changing priorities, requirements and delivery timelines.

• Language : Proficiency in English (spoken and written).

Preferred

• Certifications : ISTQB Advanced Level or equivalent QA certification.

• Knowledge of database systems (SQL, NoSQL) and API testing tools (e.g., Postman, Newman, REST Assured).

• Understanding of system architecture and software integration testing.

• Familiarity with performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, k6, Gatling).

• Understanding of cybersecurity principles and secure software testing practices.

• Experience with test data management and environment configuration.

• Knowledge of performance, load, and security testing principles.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance : Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data : Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job:
 The Financial Controller will oversee financial reporting, audit coordination, and accounting operations across a multi-entity investment and treasury platform. The role requires a technically strong finance professional with deep accounting expertise, strong operational discipline, and the ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

• Prepare accurate and timely financial statements, management accounts, and supporting reports in accordance with IFRS and US GAAP.

• Manage day-to-day accounting operations across multiple entities and jurisdictions.

• Oversee month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes, including general ledger reconciliations and control reviews.

• Maintain oversight of accounts payable, accounts receivable, accruals, and balance sheet reconciliations.

• Lead coordination with external auditors, ensuring timely delivery of audit requests, supporting documentation, and issue resolution.

• Support preparation of any regulatory, tax, statutory and ad hoc reporting requirements.

• Strengthen and maintain internal controls, accounting policies, and financial governance frameworks.

• Drive continuous improvement across accounting processes, reporting workflows, and operational controls.

• Leverage technology and automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and reporting accuracy.

• Partner closely with operations to ensure integrity of financial data and reporting.

• Assist with implementation and optimisation of financial systems and reporting infrastructure.

• Support ad hoc financial analysis, projects, and strategic initiatives as required.

Qualifications & Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related field; ACCA, ACA, CPA, CFA, or equivalent certifications.

• 10+ years of experience in financial control, audit, or accounting, preferably at a credit hedge fund. Prior experience in digital assets or blockchain ecosystems is a distinct advantage.

• Proficiency in Xero and Enfusion portfolio management system.

• Proficiency in Excel + VBA / Python is mandatory.

• Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Strong understanding of regulatory and tax requirements.

• Excellent attention to detail and communication skills.

 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

This is a role for someone who is genuinely obsessed with product. You will own the full lifecycle of a crypto wallet product used at global scale, from writing the first user story to shipping the feature to measuring what it actually did. You will set the roadmap, drive every sprint, and be the person every engineer, designer, and stakeholder looks to when a decision needs to be made.

You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.

If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you.

Key responsibilities:

• Product development and Roadmap: Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation and requirements gathering to delivery and post-launch analysis. Define user stories, acceptance criteria, perform backlog management and workflows for development teams.

• Technical Expertise: Translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable product requirements. Evaluate technical solutions and prioritize features based on technical feasibility, business impact, and customer value.

• Conduct extensive market research, including customer discovery to understand the value proposition of our product.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with developers, designers, and other stakeholders to gather requirements, validate and deliver solutions.

• Quality & Delivery: Ensure product features are delivered on time and meet quality standards; organize testing and feedback loops.

Mandatory:

• 8+ years of product management experience with at least 3 years in a technical product management role.

• Past experience in building or managing crypto wallets with DeFi features.

• Excellent communication skills for bridging technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• A genuine team player who builds trust quickly, communicates with candor, and makes the people around them more effective.

• Bias toward action. You identify what needs to change, build the case, and move without waiting to be asked.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and get engineers, designers, and business stakeholders pulling toward the same outcome at the same time.

• Equally comfortable setting the strategy and rolling up your sleeves to execute it. You do not hand things off and disappear.

• Thrives in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. You do your best work when the stakes are high and the timeline is short.

• Expertise in agile methodologies - Jira, Asana etc.

• Strong understanding of microservices, peer-to-peer systems, javascript.

• Strong organizational skills to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced, remote environment.

• Skilled in defining, tracking, and reporting on product KPIs to measure success; expertise in A/B testing or similar experimentation methods is a plus.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

About the job
 Tether is seeking a highly skilled and versatile Internal Audit Manager to support the execution of its global internal audit program. The role involves independently assessing the effectiveness of internal controls, governance processes, and risk management practices across financial operations, business workflows, and technology systems.

Operating in a fast paced digital asset environment, the ideal candidate will have a strong background in operational and financial audits from a leading consulting or audit firm.

This role will serve as a key member of the Internal Audit Team, shaping strategic decisions, delivering risk based insights to senior stakeholders, and building a resilient risk culture that supports long term growth.

Responsibilities

Audit Planning & Execution

• Plan and execute risk based audits across financial, operational, and technology areas in line with the internal audit plan.

• Develop audit scopes informed by enterprise risk assessments and emerging threats.

• Lead walkthroughs and direct fieldwork with structured testing, sampling, and evidence standards.

• Oversee audit working papers and workflow documentation to professional standards.

Controls & Governance Assurance

• Evaluate the effectiveness of internal controls and risk management practices across processes and systems.

• Assess governance, policy adherence, and regulatory compliance.

• Test design and operating effectiveness of key controls and identify gaps across the firm’s lines of defense.

Technology & Systems Assurance

• Review critical systems and platforms for control design, security, and operational integrity.

• Assess application controls, access, change management, and data integrity.

• Provide independent assurance over new initiatives, system implementations, and emerging technology adoption.

Reporting, Remediation & Stakeholder Engagement

• Prepare audit reports and communicate findings to senior leadership and the Audit Committee.

• Provide practical, risk based recommendations and own remediation tracking through to closure.

• Collaborate with Finance, Technology, Risk, and Compliance to validate observations and escalate significant exposures.

Risk Culture & Continuous Improvement

• Promote a strong risk and control culture across the organization through audit engagement and awareness.

• Stay current on industry developments, emerging risks, and regulatory frameworks.

• Apply IIA standards and contribute to the evolution of audit methodologies and quality processes.

Requirements

• 5–8 years of internal audit or assurance experience spanning financial, operational, and technology risk domains.

• Big 4 or top-tier consulting background strongly preferred.

• CPA, CA or CIA required; CISA, CISM or similar strongly advantageous.

• Highly preferred: Strong knowledge of blockchain architecture, DeFi platforms, crypto custody models, and the related IT control landscape.

• Solid grounding in financial reporting frameworks and internal control design.

• Highly preferred: Familiarity with global digital asset regulatory frameworks.

• Sharp critical thinking and analytical skills, with the ability to translate technical issues into actionable recommendations.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, including audit report writing for senior stakeholders.

• Proven ability to work independently and deliver in a fast paced, remote first environment

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 We're hiring a UX Researcher to work horizontally across Tether's full product portfolio from consumer apps like Keet, QVAC Workbench, and the Tether Wallet, to the developer portals and platforms behind QVAC, Pears, MDK, and WDK.
 This isn't a typical UX research role. The breadth is the point: one week you're studying how someone in Lagos uses USDt on their phone, the next you're sitting with engineers to figure out the best practice of developer portals. We need someone with genuine curiosity, depth of thinking, and the ability to communicate findings clearly enough that product designers and product managers make better decisions because of them. The goal is simple and never changes: the best possible experience for the user.

Responsibilities

• Run UX research across Tether's consumer and developer products: Keet, QVAC Workbench, Tether Wallet, developer portals, and more

• Identify UX best practices and emerging patterns across each product category

• Research competitors and adjacent products to surface how others are solving comparable problems, and where the gaps are

• Translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations for product designers and product managers

• Partner with product teams across all four pillars (Stable Finance, Stable Intelligence, Stable Power, Stable Communications) to inform decisions at every stage of the product lifecycle

• Build and maintain a research repository so insights compound over time and are reusable across teams

• Tailor methods to each product qualitative, quantitative, lightweight, deep whatever the question actually needs

• 5+ years of UX research experience across consumer and/or developer products

• End-to-end research chops: defining the question, picking the method, executing, synthesizing, and communicating outcomes

• Strong command of qualitative methods (interviews, usability testing, contextual inquiry) and working familiarity with quantitative ones

• Working knowledge of at least one of: crypto wallets and self-custody, messaging or P2P, AI applications, or developer tooling

• Sharp written and verbal communication — able to convert ambiguous findings into decision-ready recommendations

• Experience with products where trust, privacy, security, money movement, or technical complexity affect the user experience.

• Mandatory AI fluency: you must actively use AI tools to speed up research planning, synthesis, insight mapping, documentation, and reporting, while applying strong human judgement.

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to convert messy findings into clear, decision-ready recommendations for Design, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and leadership.

• Strong product judgement: able to separate signal from noise and identify which insights should influence the product.

• Comfortable working in fast-moving environments where research needs to be practical, focused, and useful.

• Genuine curiosity, critical thinking, and depth of analysis that goes beyond surface-level observations.

• Low-ego collaboration style, with the ability to challenge assumptions clearly and constructively.

• Genuine curiosity and depth of thinking that goes beyond surface-level observations

Bonus points:

• Background researching developer audiences and developer experience specifically

• Drive community and stakeholder engagement programs aligned with social license and ESG commitments.

• Monitor program risks, dependencies, and critical path; implement mitigation plans and escalate issues to the steering committee.

• Establish governance, reporting cadences, and KPIs across projects; produce executive-level updates.

• Oversee program budgets, capital expenditure tracking, and vendor/contract management.

• Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, international mining standards, and HSE requirements.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Mining Engineering, Geology, Industrial Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification in Project/Program Management, Business, or related field preferred.

• Solid understanding of the mining lifecycle: exploration, feasibility, permitting, construction, and operations.

• 6+ years of progressive experience in the mining industry, with at least 3-5 years managing complex programs or multi-project portfolios.

• Program/project management certification (PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent) strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated experience working with government authorities, regulators, and local communities, ideally in Latin America.

• Track record managing budgets, schedules, and multidisciplinary teams in greenfield or brownfield mining environments.

• Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and cross-cultural communication skills.

• Excellent planning, organizational, and risk-management capabilities.

• Proficiency in program management tools (MS Project, Primavera, or equivalent) and reporting platforms.

• Strong written and verbal communication in Spanish and English.

• Sound judgment, problem-solving ability, and resilience in complex, high-visibility environments.

About the job
 We are looking for an automation-driven and hands-on People Technology Analyst whose primary mission will be to review, streamline, and automate our global People Operations processes. In this role, you will audit our existing workflows, identify manual bottlenecks, and leverage our HR tech stack to build highly efficient, automated solutions while elevating our People Analytics capabilities.
 The ideal candidate has a passion for operational efficiency, an analytical mindset, and a proven track record of transforming fragmented, manual tasks into scalable, automated workflows that improve the overall employee and team experience.

Responsibilities

• Workflow Audit & Process Automation: Continuously map, review, and audit existing People Operations processes (e.g., onboarding, offboarding, contract changes, data updates) to identify inefficiencies. Design and implement automation strategies to eliminate manual tasks and friction points.

• HR Tech Stack Optimization: Act as the main system administrator for our HRIS (HiBob) and associated tools. Configure advanced automated workflows, custom triggers, alerts, and approvals to ensure seamless operations across global teams.

• System Integrations & Data Syncing: Oversee and optimize api-driven or native integrations between our HRIS (HiBob), ATS (Recruitee), and Finance tools (Payhawk) and others such Slack, Confluence and Harvest. Ensure data flows automatically and securely between platforms without requiring manual data entry.

• Data Governance & Analytics: Establish automated data validation rules to protect data integrity. Design, build, and maintain automated dashboards and reports (tracking headcount, turnover, and talent acquisition metrics) to deliver real-time, actionable insights.

• Continuous Improvement & Scale: Stay ahead of HR technology trends and new feature releases within our existing tools (specifically HiBob updates) to proactively suggest and implement process improvements.

• User Enablement & Documentation: Create clear documentation for newly automated processes to ensure high adoption rates and self-sufficiency across the organization.

• Proven HR Tech Experience: 3+ years of experience managing, configuring, and deploying workflows in HRIS/ATS platforms within fast-growing or international environments.

• Process Optimization & Automation Mindset: Proven experience in business process mapping, workflow redesign, and implementing automation logic within HR ecosystems.

• HiBob & Recruitee Expertise: Direct experience configuring platform architecture, complex automated approval chains, and multi-conditional workflows in HiBob and Recruitee (or similar tools). HiBob experience will be a strong advantage.

• Data & Analytics Mastery: Strong analytical mindset with proficiency in Google Sheets and data visualization tools (e.g., Looker Studio, PowerBI) to track process efficiency and HR metrics.

• Problem-Solving & Tech Savviness: Deep understanding of how software systems interact, including integration logic (APIs) and data mapping.

• Bilingual Proficiency: Professional fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti a Tether e Forma il futuro della finanza digitale A Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare senza soluzione di continuità i gettoni di riserva in blockchains. Imbragando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere gettoni digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto ad una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione. Innovare con Tether Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta il più affidabile stablecoin al mondo, USDT , basato su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme ai servizi di tokenizzazione degli asset digitali. Ma questo è solo l’inizio: Tether Power: Guidare la crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano il potere in eccesso per l'estrazione mineraria di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche eco-friendly nelle strutture all'avanguardia e geo-diverse. Tether Data: Riduciamo i costi delle infrastrutture e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET , la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione dei dati sicura e privata. Tether Education: Democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, forniamo agli individui di prosperare nelle economie digitali e di gig, guidando la crescita globale e l'opportunità. Tether Evolution: All'incrocio tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, realizzando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti. Perché unirsi a noi? Il nostro team è una centrale di talento globale, che lavora a distanza da ogni angolo del mondo. Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti veloci, siamo stati magra, e assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore. Se avete eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese e siete pronti a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto per voi. Sei pronto a far parte del futuro? Riguardo al lavoro Siamo alla ricerca di un analizzatore di tecnologia popolare guidato dall'automazione e pratico, la cui missione principale sarà quella di rivedere, semplificare e automatizzare i nostri processi operativi globali. In questo ruolo, verificherai i nostri flussi di lavoro esistenti, identificherai i colli di bottiglia manuali, e leverai il nostro stack di tecnologia HR per costruire soluzioni automatizzate altamente efficienti, aumentando al contempo le nostre capacità di People Analytics. Il candidato ideale ha una passione per l'efficienza operativa, una mentalità analitica, e una comprovata traccia record di trasformazione frammentata, compiti manuali in flussi di lavoro scalabili e automatizzati che migliorano l'esperienza complessiva dei dipendenti e del team. responsabilità
• Audit & Process Automation: mappa, revisione e verifica dei processi di gestione delle persone esistenti (ad esempio, onboarding, offboarding, modifiche dei contratti, aggiornamenti dei dati) per identificare le inefficienze. Progettare e implementare strategie di automazione per eliminare compiti manuali e punti di attrito.
• HR Tech Stack Optimization: agire come amministratore principale del sistema per il nostro HRIS (HiBob) e strumenti associati. Configurare flussi di lavoro automatizzati avanzati, trigger personalizzati, avvisi e approvazioni per garantire operazioni senza interruzioni in team globali.
• Integrazioni di sistema e sincronizzazione dei dati: supervisionare e ottimizzare le integrazioni api-driven o native tra il nostro HRIS (HiBob), ATS (Recruitee), e strumenti di finanza (Payhawk) e altri come Slack, Confluence e Harvest. Assicurare flussi di dati automaticamente e in modo sicuro tra piattaforme senza richiedere l'inserimento manuale dei dati.
• Gestione dei dati e analisi: stabilire regole di convalida automatizzate dei dati per proteggere l'integrità dei dati. Progettare, costruire e mantenere cruscotti e report automatizzati (tracking headcount, fatturato e metriche di acquisizione del talento) per fornire intuizioni in tempo reale, attuabili.
• Miglioramento continuo & Scale: Mantenere in anticipo le tendenze tecnologiche HR e le nuove versioni di funzionalità all'interno dei nostri strumenti esistenti (specificamente gli aggiornamenti HiBob) per suggerire e implementare proattivamente i miglioramenti del processo.
• Attivazione e documentazione dell'utente: creare una documentazione chiara per i processi automatizzati di recente per garantire elevati tassi di adozione e autosufficienza in tutta l'organizzazione.
• Prove HR Tech Experience: 3+ anni di esperienza di gestione, configurazione e distribuzione dei flussi di lavoro nelle piattaforme HRIS/ATS all'interno di ambienti in rapida crescita o internazionali.
• Ottimizzazione dei processi e automazione Mindset: comprovata esperienza nella mappatura dei processi aziendali, nella riprogettazione del flusso di lavoro e nell'implementazione della logica di automazione all'interno degli ecosistemi HR.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
We are looking for an automation-driven and hands-on People Technology Analyst whose primary mission will be to review, streamline, and automate our global People Operations processes. In this role, you will audit our existing workflows, identify manual bottlenecks, and leverage our HR tech stack to build highly efficient, automated solutions while elevating our People Analytics capabilities.
The ideal candidate has a passion for operational efficiency, an analytical mindset, and a proven track record of transforming fragmented, manual tasks into scalable, automated workflows that improve the overall employee and team experience.

Responsibilities

• Workflow Audit & Process Automation: Continuously map, review, and audit existing People Operations processes (e.g., onboarding, offboarding, contract changes, data updates) to identify inefficiencies. Design and implement automation strategies to eliminate manual tasks and friction points.

• HR Tech Stack Optimization: Act as the main system administrator for our HRIS (HiBob) and associated tools. Configure advanced automated workflows, custom triggers, alerts, and approvals to ensure seamless operations across global teams.

• System Integrations & Data Syncing: Oversee and optimize api-driven or native integrations between our HRIS (HiBob), ATS (Recruitee), and Finance tools (Payhawk) and others such Slack, Confluence and Harvest. Ensure data flows automatically and securely between platforms without requiring manual data entry.

• Data Governance & Analytics: Establish automated data validation rules to protect data integrity. Design, build, and maintain automated dashboards and reports (tracking headcount, turnover, and talent acquisition metrics) to deliver real-time, actionable insights.

• Continuous Improvement & Scale: Stay ahead of HR technology trends and new feature releases within our existing tools (specifically HiBob updates) to proactively suggest and implement process improvements.

• User Enablement & Documentation: Create clear documentation for newly automated processes to ensure high adoption rates and self-sufficiency across the organization.

• Proven HR Tech Experience: 3+ years of experience managing, configuring, and deploying workflows in HRIS/ATS platforms within fast-growing or international environments.

• Process Optimization & Automation Mindset: Proven experience in business process mapping, workflow redesign, and implementing automation logic within HR ecosystems.

• HiBob & Recruitee Expertise: Direct experience configuring platform architecture, complex automated approval chains, and multi-conditional workflows in HiBob and Recruitee (or similar tools). HiBob experience will be a strong advantage.

• Data & Analytics Mastery: Strong analytical mindset with proficiency in Google Sheets and data visualization tools (e.g., Looker Studio, PowerBI) to track process efficiency and HR metrics.

• Problem-Solving & Tech Savviness: Deep understanding of how software systems interact, including integration logic (APIs) and data mapping.

• Bilingual Proficiency: Professional fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Rejoignez Tether et formez l'avenir du financement numérique Chez Tether, nous ne sommes pas seulement des produits de construction, nous sommes pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises, depuis les échanges et les portefeuilles jusqu'aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques de billets, d'intégrer de façon transparente les jetons à l'aide de réserves dans les chaînes de blocs. En exploitant la puissance de la technologie blockchain, Tether vous permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, en toute sécurité et globalement, à une fraction du coût. La transparence est le fondement de tout ce que nous faisons, assurant la confiance dans chaque transaction. Innover avec Tether Tether Finance: Notre suite de produits innovants dispose de la plus fiable écurie du monde, USDT, sur laquelle s'appuient des centaines de millions de monde entier, ainsi que des services de tokenisation numériques. Mais c'est juste le début: Tether Power : Pour une croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l'excès de puissance pour l'exploitation minière Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques écologiques dans les installations géo-divers de pointe. Tether Data: En alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie pair à pair, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET , notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé. Tether Education : Démocratisant l'accès à l'apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous autorisons les individus à prospérer dans les économies numériques et de concerts, moteur de la croissance et des opportunités mondiales. Évolution de l'enseignement : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, écrivant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Notre équipe est une puissance mondiale de talents, travaillant à distance de tous les coins du monde. Si vous êtes passionné par la marque dans l'espace fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les frontières et de fixer de nouvelles normes. Nous avons grandi rapidement, sommes restés maigres et nous avons obtenu notre place de leader dans l'industrie. Si vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication anglaise et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est l'endroit pour vous. Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ? Sur le travail Nous sommes à la recherche d'un analyste de la technologie des personnes axé sur l'automatisation et pratique dont la mission principale sera d'examiner, de rationaliser et d'automatiser nos processus d'exploitation des personnes à l'échelle mondiale. Dans ce rôle, vous auditerez nos workflows existants, identifierez les goulets d'étranglement manuels et tirerez parti de notre pile de technologies RH pour construire des solutions hautement efficaces et automatisées tout en augmentant nos capacités d'analyse des personnes. Le candidat idéal a une passion pour l'efficacité opérationnelle, un état d'esprit analytique et une expérience éprouvée de transformation de tâches manuelles fragmentées en flux de travail évolutifs et automatisés qui améliorent l'expérience globale des employés et des équipes. Responsabilités
• Vérification des flux de travail et automatisation des processus : cartographier, examiner et vérifier en permanence les processus d'exploitation des ressources humaines existants (p. ex., à bord, hors-bord, changements contractuels, mises à jour des données) afin de déceler les inefficacités. Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des stratégies d'automatisation pour éliminer les tâches manuelles et les points de friction.
• Optimisation de la pile HR Tech : agir en tant que principal administrateur système pour notre HRIS (HiBob) et les outils associés. Configurer les workflows automatisés avancés, les déclencheurs personnalisés, les alertes et les approbations pour assurer des opérations sans faille dans les équipes mondiales.
• Intégrations système et synchronisation des données : Surveiller et optimiser les intégrations api ou natives entre nos outils HRIS (HiBob), ATS (Recruitee) et Finance (Payhawk) et d'autres tels que Slack, Confluence et Harvest. Veiller à ce que les données circulent automatiquement et en toute sécurité entre les plates-formes sans nécessiter une saisie manuelle des données.
• Gouvernance et analyse des données: Établir des règles de validation des données automatisées pour protéger l'intégrité des données. Concevoir, construire et tenir à jour des tableaux de bord et des rapports automatisés (suivant le nombre d'employés, le chiffre d'affaires et les mesures d'acquisition de talents) pour fournir des renseignements en temps réel et exploitables.
• Amélioration et échelle continues : demeurez en avance sur les tendances de la technologie des RH et sur les nouveautés de nos outils existants (notamment les mises à jour HiBob) pour suggérer et mettre en oeuvre des améliorations proactives.

• Expérience éprouvée en RH Tech : 3+ ans d'expérience en gestion, configuration et déploiement de workflows sur les plateformes HRIS/ATS dans des environnements à croissance rapide ou internationaux.
• Optimisation et automatisation des processus Mindset: Expérience éprouvée dans la cartographie des processus d'affaires, la refonte des flux de travail et la mise en œuvre de la logique d'automatisation au sein des écosystèmes RH.
• Expertise de HiBob & Recruee : Expérience directe de configuration de l'architecture de la plateforme, des chaînes d'approbation automatisées complexes et des workflows multiconditionnels dans HiBob et Recruee (ou des outils similaires). L'expérience HiBob sera un avantage important.

About the job
 We are looking for a versatile and high-energy Brands Event Coordinator to manage a diverse portfolio of events and brand-specific activations and events. In this role, you will coordinate high-impact events for our various internal brands—ensuring each one reflects our world-class standards while maintaining its own unique brand identity.
 You won't just be working solo; you will be a vital part of our global events engine. When you aren't leading your own brand events, you will be the "right hand" to our senior team members on major international events.

Responsibilities

• End-to-End Execution: Lead the coordination of international events from initial concept and booth design through to on-site execution and post-event reporting.

• Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary liaison between global venues, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure seamless service delivery.

• Logistics & Operations : Master the "fine print" by managing complex calendars, scheduling cross-functional meetings, overseeing intricate travel, event logistics, Finance & Budget coordination.

• Financial Oversight : Support the Expansion Team with budget reconciliation, expense tracking, and detailed performance reporting.

• Internal Logistics : Manage calendars, schedule meetings, and coordinate travel logistics.

• Global Communication : Manage both internal and external communications, ensuring the brand voice is consistent across English and Spanish-speaking markets.

• Bachelor’s Degree in Event Management or Bachelor’s Degree in Hospitality & Tourism Management

• A willingness and availability to travel when required.

• Experience: 5+ years of proven success in global corporate events or the professional event industry.

• Linguistic Versatility: Native or full professional proficiency in English and Spanish is required. (Bonus points if you speak Italian).

• Tech-Savviness: Advanced proficiency in Google Suite and Microsoft Office, with the ability to quickly adopt new project management tools.

• A solid grasp of budgeting, invoicing, and expense management.

• Adaptability: A "no task too big or small" mindset, comfortable moving from high-level sponsorship strategy to the ground-level execution.

About the job
 We are seeking a seasoned Real Estate Portfolio Manager to take full ownership of monitoring, managing, and reporting on an approximately $1 billion portfolio of real estate investments. The portfolio spans third-party managed funds, co-investment Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs), and a selective number of directly held assets, with a pronounced focus on commercial real estate — principally hospitality — complemented by selective residential exposure. This is not a transaction origination role. The focus is portfolio oversight, manager accountability, asset performance monitoring, and investment committee support.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. The successful candidate will serve as the primary analytical and operational interface between the Investment Committee and the external ecosystem of fund managers, asset operators, development partners, and advisors. They will be expected to challenge assumptions with rigour, add value through independent judgment, and hold third parties to a standard of performance, transparency, and accountability commensurate with the capital at stake. The successful candidate must be comfortable independently challenging fund managers, operators, consultants, and valuation assumptions — including when views differ from consensus.

Responsibilities
 Portfolio Monitoring & Fund Oversight
 ○ Fund oversight, performance and benchmarking: Act as the primary point ofaccountability for all third-party managed fund relationships. Review monthlyreporting packages and fund’s information with a critical eye — tracking keymetrics, benchmarking performance, identifying emerging risks, and escalating material deviations from plan.

○ Assumption challenging & pipeline review: Actively challenge underwriting assumptions presented by fund managers and operating partners: cap rates, exit yields, rent growth, occupancy assumptions, development timelines and construction budgets. Leverage market data and comparable evidence to validate or challenge key projections and investment decisions.

SPV & Direct Investment Management
 ○ Financial oversight and liquidity monitoring: Review and challenge budgets, liquidity forecasts, cash flow projections and capital requirements prepared by local operating partners and SPV management teams. Monitor cash positions, funding requirements and drawdown schedules, escalating potential liquidity constraints, cost overruns or capital call requirements to the Investment Committee and Treasury as appropriate.

○ Performance monitoring and variance analysis: Perform rigorous monthly andquarterly variance analysis of actual performance vs. budget, producing clear and actionable IC commentary.

Development Project Monitoring
 ○ Project monitoring and Site visits: Conduct structured site visits to active development projects to assess physical progress against approved business plans and timelines. Review and challenge project schedules, milestone achievement, cost-to-complete estimates and delivery risks, producing site visit reports with clear findings, photographic evidence and recommended actions.
 ○ Cost control & risk management: Review project cost reports, construction drawdown requests, and change order logs - challenging unjustified cost escalations and ensuring contingency utilisation is properly documented. Maintain and update a project-level risk register covering planning, construction, market, and operational risks, with clearly assigned mitigants.

Third-Party Relationship Management
 ○ Stakeholder management & governance: Serve as the main day-to-day interface with fund managers, asset managers, property managers, development companies, hotel operators, and advisors. Participate actively in advisory boards, investor committees, representing Tether’s interests and ensuring key outcomes are documented and tracked.
 ○ Reporting standards & manager accountability: Establish and enforce reporting standards, timelines and information requirements across third-party managers and operators. Hold counterparties accountable against agreed budgets, KPIs, timelines and business plans, escalating material concerns where appropriate.
 ○ Board Representation: As required, act as a director, board observer or shareholder representative on portfolio companies, subsidiaries, SPVs and other investment vehicles, fulfilling governance responsibilities and protecting Tether's interests.

IC Reporting & Decision Support
 ○ Portfolio reporting & dashboards: Prepare high-quality IC reports on a monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc basis — covering performance, key developments, risks, and recommended actions. Develop and maintain asset-level and portfolio-level dashboards tracking KPIs (occupancy, RevPAR, GOP, etc.) against business plan targets.
 ○ Forward-looking analysis & investment recommendations: Provide scenario analysis and sensitivity testing around refinancing cliffs, exit timing, and market value movements. Author and support investment memoranda for new commitments and follow-on investments, ensuring the IC has a thoroughly researched, independently verified view before committing capital.

Qualifications:

● Minimum of 8–12 years of progressive experience in real estate investment management, asset management, or a closely adjacent field (fund of funds, real estate private equity, or institutional asset management).
 ● Demonstrable experience managing or overseeing a real estate portfolio of significant scale — ideally in excess of €500M in aggregate value.
 ● Strong track record working with closed-end and/or open-end real estate fund structures, with a solid understanding of fund structures, LPAs, governance frameworks, capital calls, distributions, and GP/LP dynamics.
 ● Experience overseeing SPV structures, directly held investments and third-party operating partners, with a strong understanding of governance, reporting and capital allocation considerations.
 ● Demonstrated ability to oversee and challenge external fund managers, operators, development partners, and advisors, holding counterparties accountable against agreed business plans, budgets, timelines, and performance targets.
 ● Prior exposure to hospitality real estate — whether through hotel asset management, operator negotiations, or hotel-specific investment underwriting — is strongly preferred and will be weighted heavily.
 ● Experience attending and contributing to investment committees, board meetings, or advisory committees.
 ● Academic background: Degree-level education in Finance, Economics, Real Estate, Business Administration, or a related discipline. A professional qualification such as CFA, MRICS, or equivalent is viewed favourably.
 ● Expert-level financial modelling capability: construction and interrogation of cash flow models, DCF valuations, waterfall distribution models.
 ● Ability to read, interpret, and critically assess fund financial statements, NAV calculations, and asset valuations prepared by independent appraisers.
 ● Strong understanding of real estate operating economics, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis, with the ability to critically assess and challenge business plans and operating assumptions.
 ● Experience reviewing and supporting private real estate valuation processes, including interaction with Finance teams, auditors, valuation advisors, and external stakeholders.
 ● Ability to read and navigate key commercial and investment documentation, including LPAs, SPAs, SHAs, financing agreements, development management agreements, and operating contracts, with sufficient commercial judgment to identify key issues and effectively brief counsel.
 ● Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex operational, financial, and valuation matters into concise recommendations and decision-ready materials for senior management and Investment Committee audiences.
